#include "mlir/IR/SymbolTable.h"
#include "mlir/Transforms/DialectConversion.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/DenseMap.h"

namespace M::MOGG {
class AsyncRoutineOp;
}

namespace M::MGP {

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MOGraphLoweringState
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// State for lowering one mo.graph to a mgp.model, shared by MOGGToMGP and
/// LowerableToMGPInterface implementers and built up as ops are lowered.
class MOGraphLoweringState {
public:
  MOGraphLoweringState(M::MO::GraphOp graph,
                       llvm::StringRef compiledFrameworkLabel,
                       size_t minimumCpuAlignment,
                       mlir::SymbolTable &moduleSymbolTable)
      : graph(graph), common(compiledFrameworkLabel, minimumCpuAlignment),
        init(graph.getContext()), execute(graph.getContext()),
        moduleSymbolTable(moduleSymbolTable) {
    builderContext.hostDevice = M::getHostDevice(graph);

    typeConverter.addConversion(
        [this](MO::TensorType type) -> std::optional<Type> {
          return getTypeBuilder(MO::getDeviceOrDefault(type))
              .tensorType(MGP::createTensorSpecType(type), /*mut=*/false,
                          type.isStable());
        });
    typeConverter.addConversion(
        [this](MO::BufferType bufferType) -> std::optional<Type> {
          // Buffers lower to mutable tensors: the `mut` marker is the only
          // record of in-place semantics past this boundary.
          auto type = MO::BufferType::toTensorType(bufferType);
          return getTypeBuilder(MO::getDeviceOrDefault(type))
              .tensorType(MGP::createTensorSpecType(type), /*mut=*/true);
        });
    typeConverter.addConversion([this](
                                    MO::ListType type) -> std::optional<Type> {
      auto tensorTy = dyn_cast<MO::TensorType>(type.getElementType());
      // TODO(#29947): Support other element types
      ASSERT_STREAM(tensorTy, << "only support lowering list of tensors");

      MLIRContext *ctx = type.getContext();
      MGP::TensorSpecType tensorSpecTy = MGP::createTensorSpecType(tensorTy);
      DeviceRefAttr tensorDeviceRef = MO::getDeviceOrDefault(tensorTy);
      auto mgpTensorTy =
          getTypeBuilder(tensorDeviceRef).tensorType(tensorSpecTy);
      return MGP::ListType::get(ctx, mgpTensorTy);
    });
    typeConverter.addConversion([](MO::ScalarType type) -> std::optional<Type> {
      auto errOrDtype = MO::toMLIRType(type.getContext(), type.getDtype());

      if (errOrDtype.isError()) {
        return std::nullopt;
      }

      return *errOrDtype;
    });

    typeConverter.addConversion([](MO::OpaqueType type) -> std::optional<Type> {
      return OpaqueType::get(type.getContext(), type.getSymbol(), std::nullopt);
    });

    typeConverter.addConversion([](MO::ChainType type) -> std::optional<Type> {
      return MEF::ChainType::get(type.getContext());
    });

    // Foreign types.
    typeConverter.addConversion([](Type type) -> std::optional<Type> {
      if (auto interface = dyn_cast<ConvertibleToMGPTypeInterface>(type))
        return interface.convertType();
      return {};
    });
  }

  ErrorOr<ElementsAttr> lowerElementsAttr(ElementsAttr elementsAttr);

  /// Common state used by both the init and execute phases.
  struct CommonState {
    explicit CommonState(llvm::StringRef compiledFrameworkLabel,
                         size_t minimumCpuAlignment)
        : compiledFrameworkLabel(compiledFrameworkLabel),
          minimumCpuAlignment(minimumCpuAlignment) {}

    MGP::ModelOp modelOp;

    /// The name of the target framework, e.g. "mgp", "tf", etc.
    llvm::StringRef compiledFrameworkLabel;

    /// For all CPU buffers, constant and allocated.
    size_t minimumCpuAlignment;

    CommonState(const CommonState &) = delete;
    void operator=(const CommonState &) = delete;
  };

  /// State used when building an invokable for the 'init' phase.
  struct InitState {
    InitState(MLIRContext *ctx) : builder(ctx) {}

    Value chain;

    MGP::ContextCreateOp mgpContext;

    /// This is a builder appending operations to the end of the invokable.
    OpBuilder builder;

    InitState(const InitState &) = delete;
    void operator=(const InitState &) = delete;
  };

  /// State used when building an invokable for the 'execute' phase.
  struct ExecuteState {
    ExecuteState(MLIRContext *ctx) : builder(ctx) {}

    /// The input chain passed as the first argument to the 'execute' block,
    /// or an equivalent SSA value in a control flow sub-block.
    TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> rootChain;

    /// Sequences side-effecting operations such as printing.
    TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> currentChain;

    /// Passed in as the second argument.
    TypedValue<MGP::ContextType> mgpContext;

    /// Keeps track of what runtime SSA values the graph SSA values lower to.
    DenseMap<Value, Value> loweredValues;

    /// Maps !mo.bundle SSA values to their per-element MO-level values, so
    /// consumers needn't look through the defining TensorBundleOp.
    DenseMap<Value, SmallVector<Value>> bundleElements;

    /// The chain guarding each buffer / tensor's first write; readers must
    /// depend on it.
    DenseMap<Value, Value> loweredBufferChains;

    /// Names dense_resource attributes capturing MO constants.
    size_t nextConstId = 0;

    /// This is a builder appending operations to the end of the invokable.
    OpBuilder builder;

    /// Maps a lowered assert to the lowered assert it was chained to in MO.
    DenseMap<Operation *, Operation *> parentAssert;

    ExecuteState(const ExecuteState &) = delete;
    void operator=(const ExecuteState &) = delete;
  };

  // Base class for clients that want to inject their own custom state.
  struct ClientState {
    virtual ~ClientState() = default;
  };

  bool hasClientState() const { return bool(clientState); }

  // Only to be called once.
  template <typename T>
  void initClientState(T &&initState) {
    assert(!hasClientState());
    clientState = std::make_unique<T>(std::forward<T>(initState));
  }

  template <typename T>
  T &getClientState() {
    return static_cast<T &>(*clientState);
  }

  MGP::ModelOp getModelOp() { return common.modelOp; }

  /// New module-scope symbols (e.g. kernel stubs) must be inserted through
  /// this: the pass manager never invalidates `SymbolTableAnalysis`, so
  /// downstream passes wouldn't see them otherwise.
  mlir::SymbolTable &getModuleSymbolTable() { return moduleSymbolTable; }

  void setModelOp(MGP::ModelOp modelOp) { common.modelOp = modelOp; }

  llvm::StringRef getCompiledFrameworkLabel() {
    return common.compiledFrameworkLabel;
  }

  size_t getMinimumCpuAlignment() { return common.minimumCpuAlignment; }

  MO::GraphOp &getGraph() { return graph; }

  TypeConverter &getTypeConverter() { return typeConverter; }

  Value getInitChain() { return init.chain; }

  void setInitChain(Value chain) { init.chain = chain; }

  TypedValue<DeviceContextType> getInitDevice(DeviceRefAttr dev) {
    return initDevices[dev];
  }

  void setInitDevice(DeviceRefAttr dev, TypedValue<DeviceContextType> val) {
    initDevices[dev] = val;
  }

  OpBuilder &getInitOpBuilder() { return init.builder; }

  void setInitMgpContext(MGP::ContextCreateOp mgpContext) {
    init.mgpContext = mgpContext;
  }

  MGP::ContextCreateOp &getInitMgpContext() { return init.mgpContext; }

  TypedValue<MGP::OpaqueType> getInitWeightsRegistry() {
    return cast<TypedValue<MGP::OpaqueType>>(
        common.modelOp.getInitWeightsRegistry());
  }

  OpBuilder &getExecuteOpBuilder() { return execute.builder; }

  void setExecuteMgpContext(Value mgpContext) {
    execute.mgpContext = cast<TypedValue<MGP::ContextType>>(mgpContext);
  }

  TypedValue<MGP::ContextType> getExecuteMgpContext() {
    return execute.mgpContext;
  }

  TypedValue<DeviceContextType> getExecuteDevice(DeviceRefAttr dev) {
    if (!dev)
      dev = DeviceRefAttr::getDefault(execute.builder.getContext());

    // While lowering an `mo.sequence` body onto a side stream, every op
    // lowered through here picks up the side-stream context.
    if (auto it = execDevices.find(dev); it != execDevices.end())
      return it->second;

    for (auto [deviceRefAttr, deviceContext] : llvm::zip(
             common.modelOp.getDevices(), common.modelOp.getExecuteDevices())) {
      if (deviceRefAttr == dev)
        return cast<TypedValue<MGP::DeviceContextType>>(deviceContext);
    }
    llvm_unreachable("Could not find device in model args");
  }

  /// Make `getExecuteDevice(dev)` return `ctx` (e.g. a side-stream view) until
  /// cleared. Not nestable; the MO verifier forbids nested `mo.sequence`.
  void setExecuteDeviceOverride(DeviceRefAttr dev,
                                TypedValue<DeviceContextType> ctx) {
    assert(!execDevices.count(dev) &&
           "nested execute-device override for the same device");
    execDevices[dev] = ctx;
  }

  void clearExecuteDeviceOverride(DeviceRefAttr dev) { execDevices.erase(dev); }

  TypedValue<MGP::OpaqueType> getExecuteWeightsRegistry() {
    return cast<TypedValue<MGP::OpaqueType>>(
        common.modelOp.getExecuteWeightsRegistry());
  }

  void setRootExecuteChain(Value chain) {
    execute.rootChain = cast<TypedValue<MEF::ChainType>>(chain);
  }

  /// The 'root' chain of the 'execute' block, for non-side-effecting
  /// operations.
  TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> getExecuteChain() { return execute.rootChain; }

  /// The 'current' chain of the 'execute' block, for side-effecting
  /// operations.
  Value getCurrentExecuteChain() { return execute.currentChain; }

  void setCurrentExecuteChain(Value chain) {
    execute.currentChain = cast<TypedValue<MEF::ChainType>>(chain);
  }

  /// The runtime value a mo.graph SSA value (often a `mo.tensor`) lowers to.
  Value lookupExecuteLoweredValue(Value key) {
    return execute.loweredValues.lookup(key);
  }

  Value getChainGuardingValueOrNull(Value key) {
    return execute.loweredBufferChains.lookup(key);
  }

  void guardValueWithChain(Value key, Value chain) {
    execute.loweredBufferChains.try_emplace(key, chain);
  }

  /// Overwrite an existing chain guard, e.g. after region fusion.
  void replaceChainGuard(Value key, Value newChain) {
    execute.loweredBufferChains[key] = newChain;
  }

  using ParamPlaceholderOp = ParameterLoweringState::PlaceholderOp;

  /// Record the runtime value a mo.graph SSA value lowers to.
  void emplaceExecuteLoweredValue(Value key, Value value) {
    if (auto placeholder = value.getDefiningOp<ParamPlaceholderOp>())
      placeholderMap.find(placeholder)->getSecond().emplace_back(key);

    execute.loweredValues.try_emplace(key, value);
  }

  void emplaceExecuteLoweredBufferValue(Value key, Value value, Value chain) {
    guardValueWithChain(key, chain);
    guardValueWithChain(value, chain);
    execute.loweredValues.try_emplace(key, value);
  }

  void emplaceBundleElements(Value bundleVal, SmallVector<Value> elements) {
    execute.bundleElements.try_emplace(bundleVal, std::move(elements));
  }

  SmallVector<Value> lookupBundleElements(Value bundleVal) {
    auto it = execute.bundleElements.find(bundleVal);
    ASSERT_STREAM(it != execute.bundleElements.end(),
                  << "bundle value has no registered elements");
    return it->second;
  }

  size_t getExecuteNextConstId() { return execute.nextConstId++; }

  /// Returns the shape of a lowered tensor which is on the given device.
  TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType> getShape(Location loc, Value loweredTensor,
                                           DeviceRefAttr device);

  /// Assumes the rank is known.
  SmallVector<Value> getDynamicDims(Location loc, Value loweredTensor,
                                    DeviceRefAttr device);

  MGP::TensorSpecGetDimOp getDim(Location loc, Value loweredTensor,
                                 uint64_t axis, DeviceRefAttr device);

  struct ArgLoweringResult {
    bool hasParameters;
    Value loweredArg;
  };

  /// Maps the dynamic shape parameters of `inArg` (a !mo.tensor lowered to the
  /// !mgp.tensor `outArg`) to their MGP values. Returns whether there were
  /// parameters, and `outArg` guarded by any runtime assertions.
  ErrorOr<ArgLoweringResult> lowerArg(Region *parentRegion, BlockArgument inArg,
                                      BlockArgument outArg);

  /// Lowers a parameter expression: unseen references become placeholders,
  /// operators recurse, and other attributes go to the hook.
  ErrorOr<Value> lowerExpression(Region *parentRegion, Location loc,
                                 TypedAttr attr);

  /// Lower a parameter declaration once, resolving its placeholder if any.
  ErrorOrSuccess lowerParamDecl(Region *parentRegion,
                                KGEN::ParamDeclAttr declAttr, Value value);

  /// The values of `shape`'s parametric dimensions, in order.
  ErrorOr<SmallVector<Value>> lowerShapeAttrDynDims(Region *parentRegion,
                                                    MOSH::ShapeAttr shapeAttr,
                                                    Location loc);

  const BufferBuilderContext &getBufferBuilderContext() const {
    return builderContext;
  }

  /// Register a type builder for the given device.
  void registerTypeBuilder(DeviceRefAttr device) {
    builderContext.registerTypeBuilder(device);
  }

  /// Returns the type builder to use for device.
  MGP::MGPTypeBuilder getTypeBuilder(DeviceRefAttr device) {
    return builderContext.getTypeBuilder(device);
  }

  /// Register the given buffer builder for the given device.
  void
  registerBufferBuilder(DeviceRefAttr device,
                        std::unique_ptr<MGP::MGPBufferBuilder> bufferBuilder) {
    builderContext.registerBufferBuilder(device, std::move(bufferBuilder));
  }

  /// The returned builder is owned by this object.
  MGP::MGPBufferBuilder &getBufferBuilder(DeviceRefAttr device) {
    return builderContext.getBufferBuilder(device);
  }

  /// Return the 'host' device for this graph.
  DeviceRefAttr getHostDevice() { return builderContext.hostDevice; }

  /// Returns the buffer builder to use for the 'host' device.
  MGP::MGPBufferBuilder &getHostBufferBuilder() {
    return builderContext.getHostBufferBuilder();
  }

  /// Packs outputs and unpacks inputs of a MOGG::AsyncRoutineOp.
  static void lowerMOGGABI(MOGG::AsyncRoutineOp kernelOp);

private:
  //===-----------------------------------------------------------------===//
  // Parameter lowering helpers.
  //===-----------------------------------------------------------------===//

  /// Lowers an operator attribute to the appropriate mop index op.
  static ErrorOr<Value> lowerParamOperator(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                           KGEN::ParamOperatorAttr opAttr,
                                           ValueRange operands);

  /// Lowers an integer attribute to a index constant op.
  static Operation *lowerKGENConstantAttr(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                          TypedAttr intAttr);

  /// Lower a parameter expression.
  ErrorOr<Value> lowerExpressionImpl(ParameterLoweringState &state,
                                     OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                     Region *parentRegion, TypedAttr attr,
                                     ValueRange operands);

  /// Lower a parameter expression used as a dimension.
  ErrorOr<Value> lowerDimensionExpression(ParameterLoweringState &state,
                                          OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                          Region *parentRegion, TypedAttr dim);

private:
  //===-----------------------------------------------------------------===//
  // Lowering state
  //===-----------------------------------------------------------------===//

  /// The graph being lowered.
  MO::GraphOp graph;
  /// Type converter for lowering from MO types to MGP and other
  /// device-specific types.
  TypeConverter typeConverter;

  /// All the type and buffer builders we've registered.
  BufferBuilderContext builderContext;

  CommonState common;
  InitState init;
  ExecuteState execute;

  /// Owned by the pass's `SymbolTableAnalysis`.
  mlir::SymbolTable &moduleSymbolTable;

  // Arbitrary client state.
  std::unique_ptr<ClientState> clientState;

  /// The state and interface for parameter lowering.
  ParameterLoweringState params;

  DenseMap<Value, SmallVector<Value>> placeholderMap;

  /// Mapping from device ref to value in init.
  SmallDenseMap<DeviceRefAttr, TypedValue<DeviceContextType>> initDevices;

  /// Mapping from device ref to value in exec.
  SmallDenseMap<DeviceRefAttr, TypedValue<DeviceContextType>> execDevices;
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MOOpLoweringState
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// MO ops only return !mo.tensors; other result types would need a variant.
using MOOutputStorage = BufferizedTensor;

/// Manages the value-to-buffer-semantic transition when lowering one MO op.
struct MOOpLoweringState {
  MOGraphLoweringState &loweringState;
  OpBuilder &builder;
  mlir::Operation *opBeingLowered;
  mlir::Location loc;
  TypedValue<MGP::ContextType> context;
  TypedValue<MGP::OpaqueType> weightsRegistry;
  uint64_t minimumCpuAlignment;

  MOOpLoweringState(MGP::MOGraphLoweringState &loweringState,
                    mlir::Operation *op)
      : loweringState(loweringState),
        builder(loweringState.getExecuteOpBuilder()), opBeingLowered(op),
        loc(op->getLoc()), context(loweringState.getExecuteMgpContext()),
        weightsRegistry(loweringState.getExecuteWeightsRegistry()),
        minimumCpuAlignment(loweringState.getMinimumCpuAlignment()) {}

  //===-----------------------------------------------------------------===//
  // Main API
  //===-----------------------------------------------------------------===//

  /// Returns the lowered operands: !mo.tensors as their buffer on the type's
  /// storage device, everything else as is.
  SmallVector<Value> getLoweredOperands();

  /// Merges `chain` with any other chains this op must wait on.
  Value getGuardChain(Value chain);

  /// Derives the output specs from the op's result types.
  FailureOr<SmallVector<MOOutputStorage>> createOutputStorage(Value inChain);

  /// Returns destination-passing-style storage for the op's !mo.tensor
  /// results: a fresh buffer on the storage device, paired with a tensor spec.
  FailureOr<SmallVector<MOOutputStorage>>
  createOutputStorage(Value inChain,
                      ArrayRef<TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>> outSpecs);

  /// Create the outputs from the storage and map the MO op results to them.
  void createOutputs(Value inChain,
                     SmallVector<MOOutputStorage> &loweredOutputsStorage);

  //===-----------------------------------------------------------------===//
  // Input and Output helpers
  //===-----------------------------------------------------------------===//

  /// Returns the bufferized form for the MO tensor value.
  BufferizedTensor getBufferizedInput(Value moTensor);

  FailureOr<TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>>
  createTensorSpec(MO::TensorType moTensorType);

  /// Returns the tensor specs to represent all the op's outputs.
  FailureOr<SmallVector<TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>>>
  createOutputTensorSpecs();

  /// Allocates a buffer sized for `spec` on moTensorType's storage device.
  FailureOr<BufferizedTensor>
  createBuffer(Value inChain, TypedValue<TensorSpecType> tensorSpec,
               Type moTensorType);

  /// Creates a tensor on moTensor's storage device and maps moTensor to it.
  void createOutputTensor(Value moTensor, Value inChain, Value buffer,
                          TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType> tensorSpec);

  void createOutputTensors(
      Value inChain, SmallVector<Value> &buffers,
      SmallVector<TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>> &tensorSpecs);

  //===-----------------------------------------------------------------===//
  // MLIR create helpers
  //===-----------------------------------------------------------------===//

  /// Creates an operation of specific op type at the current insertion point.
  template <typename OpTy, typename... Args>
  OpTy create(Args &&...args) {
    return OpTy::create(builder, loc, std::forward<Args>(args)...);
  }

  /// The buffer builder for moTensorType's storage device.
  MGP::MGPBufferBuilder &getStorageBufferBuilder(Type moTensorType);

  // These redirect to MGPBufferBuilder for moTensorType's storage device.

  std::pair<Value, TypedValue<TensorSpecType>>
  tensorExtract(Value loweredTensor, Type moTensorType) {
    MGP::MGPBufferBuilder &bufferBuilder =
        getStorageBufferBuilder(moTensorType);
    // Separate statements fix the op order; argument evaluation order is
    // unspecified.
    auto buffer =
        bufferBuilder.tensorExtractBuffer(builder, loc, loweredTensor);
    auto spec =
        bufferBuilder.tensorExtractTensorSpec(builder, loc, loweredTensor);
    loweringState.guardValueWithChain(
        buffer, loweringState.getChainGuardingValueOrNull(loweredTensor));
    return std::make_pair(buffer, spec);
  }

  Value tensorCreate(Value inChain, Value buffer,
                     TypedValue<TensorSpecType> tensorSpec, Type moTensorType) {
    bool isMut = isa<MO::BufferType>(moTensorType);

    Value tensor =
        getStorageBufferBuilder(moTensorType)
            .tensorCreate(builder, loc, context, inChain, buffer, tensorSpec,
                          /*mut=*/isMut);
    loweringState.guardValueWithChain(
        tensor, loweringState.getChainGuardingValueOrNull(buffer));
    return tensor;
  }

  Value hostBufferConstant(TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
                           ElementsAttr value, Type moTensorType) {
    return loweringState.getHostBufferBuilder().bufferConstant(
        builder, loc, inChain, context, value);
  }

  Value hostBufferConstantExternal(TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
                                   TypedValue<MGP::OpaqueType> name,
                                   uint64_t size, uint64_t align, bool hasAlias,
                                   bool isPlaceholder) {
    return loweringState.getHostBufferBuilder().bufferConstantExternal(
        builder, loc, inChain, context, weightsRegistry, name, size, align,
        hasAlias, isPlaceholder);
  }

  Value deviceBufferConstantExternal(DeviceRefAttr device,
                                     TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
                                     TypedValue<MGP::OpaqueType> name,
                                     uint64_t size, uint64_t align,
                                     bool hasAlias, bool isPlaceholder) {
    return loweringState.getBufferBuilder(device).bufferConstantExternal(
        builder, loc, inChain, context, weightsRegistry, name, size, align,
        hasAlias, isPlaceholder);
  }

  Value hostDebugPrint(Value inChain, StringAttr data, StringAttr label) {
    return loweringState.getHostBufferBuilder().debugPrint(
        builder, loc, context, inChain, data, label);
  }

  Value debugTensorPrint(Value inChain, Value buffer,
                         TypedValue<TensorSpecType> tensorSpec,
                         StringAttr label, Type moTensorType) {
    return getStorageBufferBuilder(moTensorType)
        .debugTensorPrint(builder, loc, context, inChain, buffer, tensorSpec,
                          label);
  }
  Value hostDebugTensorPrint(Value inChain, Value buffer,
                             TypedValue<TensorSpecType> tensorSpec,
                             StringAttr label) {
    return loweringState.getHostBufferBuilder().debugTensorPrint(
        builder, loc, context, inChain, buffer, tensorSpec, label);
  }

  Value bufferTransferFromHost(Value inChain,
                               TypedValue<MGP::DeviceBufferType> srcBuffer,
                               Value dstBuffer, Type dstMoTensorType) {
    auto deviceRef = getStorageBufferBuilder(dstMoTensorType).getDevice();
    auto deviceContext = loweringState.getExecuteDevice(deviceRef);
    auto chain =
        getStorageBufferBuilder(dstMoTensorType)
            .bufferTransferFromHost(builder, loc, context, inChain,
                                    &loweringState.getHostBufferBuilder(),
                                    srcBuffer, dstBuffer, deviceContext);
    loweringState.guardValueWithChain(dstBuffer, chain);
    return chain;
  }
  Value bufferTransferToHost(Value inChain, Value srcBuffer,
                             TypedValue<MGP::DeviceBufferType> dstBuffer,
                             Type srcMoTensorType) {
    auto deviceRef = getStorageBufferBuilder(srcMoTensorType).getDevice();
    auto deviceContext = loweringState.getExecuteDevice(deviceRef);
    return getStorageBufferBuilder(srcMoTensorType)
        .bufferTransferToHost(builder, loc, context, inChain, srcBuffer,
                              &loweringState.getHostBufferBuilder(), dstBuffer,
                              deviceContext);
  }
  Value bufferTransferDevice(Value inChain, Value srcBuffer, Value dstBuffer,
                             Type srcMoTensorType, Type dstMoTensorType) {
    // The only op spanning two devices. The D2D device context synchronizes
    // them. TODO(GEX-1859): Explicit sync to enable compute overlap.

    DeviceRefAttr srcDeviceRef =
        getStorageBufferBuilder(srcMoTensorType).getDevice();
    DeviceRefAttr dstDeviceRef =
        getStorageBufferBuilder(dstMoTensorType).getDevice();
    auto dstDeviceContext = loweringState.getExecuteDevice(dstDeviceRef);
    auto srcDeviceContext = loweringState.getExecuteDevice(srcDeviceRef);

    return getStorageBufferBuilder(srcMoTensorType)
        .bufferTransferDevice(builder, loc, context, inChain, srcBuffer,
                              &getStorageBufferBuilder(dstMoTensorType),
                              dstBuffer, srcDeviceContext, dstDeviceContext);
  }

  Value bufferConcat(Value inChain, Value outBuffer, ArrayRef<Value> inBuffers,
                     Type outMoTensorType) {
    auto ty = cast<MO::TensorType>(outMoTensorType);
    auto deviceContext = loweringState.getExecuteDevice(ty.getDeviceRef());
    return getStorageBufferBuilder(outMoTensorType)
        .bufferConcat(builder, loc, deviceContext, inChain, outBuffer,
                      inBuffers);
  }

  Value bufferSlice(Value inBuffer, Value offset, Value size,
                    Type outMoTensorType) {
    auto deviceRef = getStorageBufferBuilder(outMoTensorType).getDevice();
    auto deviceContext = loweringState.getExecuteDevice(deviceRef);
    return getStorageBufferBuilder(outMoTensorType)
        .bufferSlice(builder, loc, inBuffer, offset, size, deviceContext);
  }

  Value bufferToBool(Value inChain, Value buffer, Type moTensorType) {
    return getStorageBufferBuilder(moTensorType)
        .bufferToBool(builder, loc, context, inChain, buffer);
  }

  Value bufferSetWithIndex(Value buffer, ArrayRef<Value> values,
                           Type moTensorType) {
    return getStorageBufferBuilder(moTensorType)
        .bufferSetWithIndex(builder, loc, context, buffer, values);
  }

  Value hostBufferAlloc(TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain, Value size,
                        uint64_t align) {
    auto deviceContext =
        loweringState.getExecuteDevice(loweringState.getHostDevice());
    return loweringState.getHostBufferBuilder().bufferAlloc(
        builder, loc, context, inChain, size, deviceContext, align);
  }

  Value bufferAlloc(TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain, Value size,
                    uint64_t align, Type moTensorType) {
    auto deviceRef = getStorageBufferBuilder(moTensorType).getDevice();
    auto deviceContext = loweringState.getExecuteDevice(deviceRef);
    return getStorageBufferBuilder(moTensorType)
        .bufferAlloc(builder, loc, context, inChain, size, deviceContext,
                     align);
  }

  Value bufferSizeBytes(TypedValue<TensorSpecType> tensorSpec,
                        Type moTensorType) {
    int64_t dtypeSize =
        dyn_cast<MO::TensorType>(moTensorType).getDtype().getSizeInBytes();
    Value numBytes = mlir::index::ConstantOp::create(builder, loc, dtypeSize);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < tensorSpec.getType().getRank(); ++i) {
      Value dimVal =
          builder.createOrFold<MGP::TensorSpecGetDimOp>(loc, tensorSpec, i);
      numBytes = builder.createOrFold<mlir::index::MulOp>(
          loc, builder.getIndexType(), numBytes, dimVal);
    }
    return numBytes;
  }

  Value sync(Value chain) {
    auto device = loweringState.getHostDevice();
    auto deviceContext = loweringState.getExecuteDevice(device);
    return loweringState.getBufferBuilder(device).sync(builder, loc, context,
                                                       deviceContext, chain);
  }
};

} // namespace M::MGP

#endif // GENERICML_INTERFACES_LOWERINGSTATE_H

#ifndef GENERICML_MGPDIALECT_BUFFERBUILDER_H
#define GENERICML_MGPDIALECT_BUFFERBUILDER_H

#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Dialect/MGPOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Dialect/MGPTypes.h"
#include "Support/AssertStream.h"
#include "Support/LLVMCompilerForwardDecls.h"

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Generic parsing/printing helpers
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Parses one off:
///   ':' resultRawType
///   bufferRawType ':' resultRawType
/// In the first form the bufferRawType is derived from the resultRawType.
template <typename BufferType, typename TensorType>
ParseResult genericParseMayBeDynamicBuffer(AsmParser &parser,
                                           Type &bufferRawType,
                                           Type &resultRawType) {
  mlir::SMLoc loc;
  if (parser.getCurrentLocation(&loc))
    return failure();
  OptionalParseResult parseResult = parser.parseOptionalType(bufferRawType);
  bool hasBufferTypeAnnotation = parseResult.has_value();
  if (hasBufferTypeAnnotation) {
    if (failed(parseResult.value()))
      return failure();
    if (!isa<BufferType>(bufferRawType))
      return parser.emitError(loc)
             << "expecting !" << BufferType::getMnemonic() << " type";
  }

  if (parser.parseColon() || parser.parseType(resultRawType))
    return failure();
  auto resultTensorType = dyn_cast<TensorType>(resultRawType);
  if (resultTensorType == nullptr)
    return parser.emitError(loc)
           << "expecting !" << TensorType::getMnemonic() << " type";
  if (!hasBufferTypeAnnotation) {
    bufferRawType = BufferType::get(resultTensorType);
  }
  return success();
}

/// Prints one off:
///   ':' resultType
///   bufferType ':' resultType
/// The second form is used only if the bufferType does not match the result
/// type.
template <typename BufferType, typename TensorType>
void genericPrintMayBeDynamicBuffer(AsmPrinter &printer, const Operation *op,
                                    BufferType bufferType,
                                    TensorType resultType) {
  if (BufferType::get(resultType) != bufferType) {
    printer.printType(bufferType);
    printer.getStream() << ' ';
  }
  printer.getStream() << ": ";
  printer.printType(resultType);
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Generic verification helpers
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Checks the tensor spec, buffer type and result tensor types are consistent.
template <typename BufferType, typename TensorType>
LogicalResult genericTensorCreateVerify(Operation *op, BufferType bufferType,
                                        TensorSpecType tensorSpecType,
                                        TensorType tensorType) {
  if (tensorSpecType != tensorType.getTensorSpec())
    return op->emitOpError()
           << "expected spec to match result tensor spec" << " ("
           << tensorSpecType << " vs " << tensorType.getTensorSpec() << ")";

  BufferType expectedBufferType = BufferType::get(tensorType);
  bool bufferIsStatic = bufferType.getOptSize().has_value();
  bool expectedBufferIsStatic = expectedBufferType.getOptSize().has_value();
  if (bufferIsStatic != expectedBufferIsStatic) {
    // Buffer and tensor spec may disagree on staticness when lowering
    // value-semantic reshapes. Here %z reuses %x's buffer with a known size:
    //   %z = reshape %x, %y : (tensor<?x?xf32>, tensor<2xui32>) ->
    //   tensor<8x16xf32>
    // Conversely, in:
    //   %z = reshape %x, %y : (tensor<8x4xf32>, tensor<2xui32>) ->
    //   tensor<?x?xf32>
    // the buffer for %z will now have an unknown size.
  } else if (bufferType != expectedBufferType) {
    return op->emitOpError()
           << "expected buffer type to match type implied by tensor spec ("
           << bufferType << " vs " << expectedBufferType << ").";
  }
  return success();
}

/// Checks the buffer type and tensor types are consistent.
template <typename BufferType, typename TensorType>
LogicalResult genericTensorExtractVerify(Operation *op, TensorType tensorType,
                                         BufferType resultBufferType,
                                         TensorSpecType resultTensorSpecType) {
  if (tensorType.getTensorSpec() != resultTensorSpecType)
    return op->emitOpError()
           << "expected the result spec to match tensor's spec" << " ("
           << resultTensorSpecType << " vs " << tensorType.getTensorSpec()
           << ")";
  BufferType expectedBufferType = BufferType::get(tensorType);
  if (expectedBufferType != resultBufferType)
    return op->emitOpError()
           << "expected the result buffer to match the type "
              "implied by the tensor type ("
           << resultBufferType << " vs " << expectedBufferType << ").";
  return success();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MGPTypeBuilder
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// An MGPTypeBuilder provides methods for building device-specific tensor
/// types. It is only needed during lowering when lowered types must be
/// provided ahead of lowering itself. Otherwise the MGPBufferBuilder
/// constructs types as it goes.
class MGPTypeBuilder {
public:
  DeviceRefAttr device;

  MGPTypeBuilder(DeviceRefAttr device) : device(device) {}

  /// Returns the device-specific tensor type with the given tensor spec.
  /// `mut` marks the tensor as mutable (the lowered form of `!mo.buffer`);
  /// `stable` marks the tensor as having a stable address across dispatches.
  DeviceTensorType tensorType(TensorSpecType tensorSpecType, bool mut = false,
                              bool stable = false) {
    return DeviceTensorType::get(device, tensorSpecType, mut, stable);
  }
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MGPBufferBuilder
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// An MGPBufferBuilder provides methods for building device-dependent buffer,
/// tensor, chain and kernel ops. An instance of this class is created for
/// each device in the model and accumulates device-specific lowering state.
///
/// All values representing buffers and tensors must be in the 'native' form
/// understood by this device. However, as a convenience, chains may be in
/// either 'native' form, or be host !mef.chain chains.
class MGPBufferBuilder {
public:
  DeviceRefAttr device;

  MGPBufferBuilder(DeviceRefAttr device) : device(device) {}

  MGPBufferBuilder(const MGPBufferBuilder &) = delete;
  MGPBufferBuilder &operator=(const MGPBufferBuilder &) = delete;

  /// Set up the state for emitting ops into a ModelOp. Returns the chain
  /// indicating when the runtime has been established.
  TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> setupForModel(ModelOp modelOp,
                                           MGPBufferBuilder *hostBufferBuilder,
                                           OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                                           TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain);

  /// Recover the state from modelOp for this device-specific buffer builder.
  void recoverFromModel(ModelOp modelOp, MGPBufferBuilder *hostBufferBuilder);

  /// Returns the !mgp.context appropriate for op, or null if none can be
  /// found.
  TypedValue<ContextType> getContextForOp(Operation *op);

  DeviceRefAttr getDevice() { return device; }

  /// Returns the constant buffer with given attribute as its contents.
  Value bufferConstant(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                       TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
                       TypedValue<ContextType> context, ElementsAttr value);

  /// Returns an undefined, external constant with the given name.
  /// The name is an SSA value of type !mgp.opaque<"mojo_string">.
  Value bufferConstantExternal(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                               TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
                               TypedValue<ContextType> context,
                               TypedValue<MGP::OpaqueType> weightsRegistry,
                               TypedValue<MGP::OpaqueType> name, uint64_t size,
                               uint64_t align, bool hasAlias,
                               bool isPlaceholder);

  /// Returns the buffer held by tensor.
  Value tensorExtractBuffer(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, Value tensor);

  /// Returns the tensor spec of the given tensor.
  TypedValue<TensorSpecType>
  tensorExtractTensorSpec(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, Value tensor);

  /// Return the tensor constructed from buffer and tensor spec. If necessary
  /// the buffer will be 'unsized' or 'resized' to match the tensorSpec type.
  /// `mut` marks the result type as mutable (the lowered form of
  /// `!mo.buffer`).
  Value tensorCreate(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                     TypedValue<ContextType> context, Value inChain,
                     Value buffer, TypedValue<TensorSpecType> tensorSpec,
                     bool mut = false);

  /// Returns the buffer of size. The alignment may be ignored for some
  /// devices.
  Value bufferAlloc(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                    TypedValue<ContextType> context, Value inChain, Value size,
                    Value deviceContext, uint64_t alignment);

  /// Returns the chain indicating when srcBuffer on the host device has been
  /// transferred to dstBuffer on this builder's device.
  Value bufferTransferFromHost(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                               TypedValue<ContextType> context, Value inChain,
                               MGPBufferBuilder *srcBuilder, Value srcBuffer,
                               Value dstBuffer, Value deviceContext);

  /// Returns the !mef.chain indicating when srcBuffer on this builder's
  /// device has been transferred to dstBuffer on the host.
  Value bufferTransferToHost(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                             TypedValue<ContextType> context, Value inChain,
                             Value srcBuffer, MGPBufferBuilder *dstBuilder,
                             Value dstBuffer, Value deviceContext);

  /// Returns the chain indicating when srcBuffer on this builder's device has
  /// been transferred to dstBuffer (which resides on a different device).
  /// inChain is a device specific chain on the srcBuffer's device.
  Value bufferTransferDevice(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                             TypedValue<ContextType> context, Value inChain,
                             Value srcBuffer,
                             MGPBufferBuilder *dstBufferBuilder,
                             Value dstBuffer, Value srcDeviceContext,
                             Value dstDeviceContext);

  /// Get the runtime size of the buffer
  Value bufferGetSize(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, Value inChain,
                      Value inBuffer);

  /// Return the chain indicating the debug string has been printed.
  Value debugPrint(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                   TypedValue<ContextType> context, Value inChain,
                   StringAttr debugString, StringAttr label);

  /// Return the chain indicating tensor, in the form of buffer and tensor
  /// spec, has been printed.
  Value debugTensorPrint(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                         TypedValue<ContextType> context, Value inChain,
                         Value buffer, TypedValue<TensorSpecType> spec,
                         StringAttr label);

  /// Returns the chain indicating the given module image with given function
  /// and constant names has been loaded into the runtime.
  TypedValue<MEF::ChainType>
  moduleLoad(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, TypedValue<ContextType> context,
             TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain, ElementsAttr image,
             ArrayAttr functionSymbols, ArrayAttr constantSymbols);

  /// Returns the join of all the given chain values, which must be all native
  /// to this builder.
  Value chainCreate(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, ArrayRef<Value> inChains);

  /// Places buffer into a fresh slot of context. Returns the chain indicating
  /// placement and the slot index for later retrieval. Chains are always
  /// !mef.chain, irrespective of this builder's native chain type. Generally
  /// only appropriate within the 'init' block of an mgp.model op.
  std::pair<TypedValue<MEF::ChainType>, uint64_t>
  cache(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, TypedValue<ContextType> context,
        TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain, ContextCreateOp contextCreateOp,
        Value buffer);

  /// Retrieves a buffer of the expected type from the given slot of the given
  /// !mgp.context. Note that the input chain is always a !mef.chain,
  /// irrespective of the native chain type for this builder.
  Value getCached(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                  TypedValue<ContextType> context,
                  TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain, uint64_t bufferSlot,
                  Type expectedBufferType);

  /// Returns a chain indicating when the given input buffers have been
  /// copied into the output buffer.
  Value bufferConcat(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                     TypedValue<DeviceContextType> deviceContext, Value inChain,
                     Value outBuffer, ArrayRef<Value> inBuffers);

  Value bufferSlice(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, Value inBuffer,
                    Value offset, Value size, Value deviceContext);

  /// Returns the bool contents of a single-byte buffer.
  Value bufferToBool(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                     TypedValue<ContextType> context, Value inChain,
                     Value inBuffer);

  /// Returns the chain indicating the given index values have been assigned
  /// into the given buffer.
  Value bufferSetWithIndex(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                           TypedValue<ContextType> context, Value buffer,
                           ArrayRef<Value> values);

  /// Adds a device specific sync. Returns a ready chain once the device has
  /// synchronized.
  Value sync(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc, TypedValue<ContextType> context,
             TypedValue<DeviceContextType> deviceContext, Value chain);

  std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t> getFunction(StringRef name) {
    auto itr = functionToIndexPair.find(name);
    ASSERT_STREAM(itr != functionToIndexPair.end(),
                  << "No function has been registered for name '" << name
                  << "' in the runtime for device '" << device << "'");
    return itr->second;
  }

  std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t> getConstant(StringRef name) {
    auto itr = constantToIndexPair.find(name);
    ASSERT_STREAM(itr != constantToIndexPair.end(),
                  << "No constant has been registered for name '" << name
                  << "' in the runtime for device '" << device << "'");
    return itr->second;
  }

  uint64_t getRuntimeSlot() const { return runtimeSlot; }

private:
  /// The builder for the host device. May point to this if this is the host
  /// device buffer builder.
  MGPBufferBuilder *hostBufferBuilder = nullptr;
  /// The slot holding the runtime for this device in the !mgp.context.
  uint64_t runtimeSlot = 0;
  /// Maps the name of each compiled kernel to its (module index, function
  /// index) pair in the runtime.
  llvm::StringMap<std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>> functionToIndexPair;
  /// Maps the name of each constant to its (module index, constant index)
  /// pair in the runtime.
  llvm::StringMap<std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>> constantToIndexPair;
  /// The next available module index for the runtime associated with
  /// this device.
  uint64_t nextModuleIndex = 0;
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// BufferizedTensor
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// A representation of tensor as a pair of a buffer and its tensor spec.
/// The tensor spec is always an TensorSpecType, but the buffer type
/// depends on the device being lowered to.
struct BufferizedTensor {
  /// Written by the producing op, then read by all consumers. Its type
  /// (mgp.cpu.buffer, cuda.buffer, etc) depends on the storage device.
  Value buffer;

  /// The mgp.tensor_spec describing the shape and dtype of tensor
  /// at runtime.
  TypedValue<TensorSpecType> tensorSpec;

  BufferizedTensor() = default;

  BufferizedTensor(Value buffer, TypedValue<TensorSpecType> tensorSpec)
      : buffer(buffer), tensorSpec(tensorSpec) {}
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// BufferBuilderContext
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Collects the type and buffer builders for every device in a model.
///
/// Not thread safe. Should only be used per-model and not shared across
/// models.
class BufferBuilderContext {
public:
  /// The distinguished 'host' device.
  DeviceRefAttr hostDevice;

  BufferBuilderContext() = default;

  /// Register a type builder for the given device.
  void registerTypeBuilder(DeviceRefAttr device) {
    [[maybe_unused]] bool inserted =
        typeBuilderMap.insert({device, MGPTypeBuilder(device)}).second;
    ASSERT_STREAM(inserted,
                  << "a type builder has already been registered for device");
  }

  /// Returns the type builder to use for device.
  MGPTypeBuilder getTypeBuilder(DeviceRefAttr device) const {
    auto itr = typeBuilderMap.find(device);
    ASSERT_STREAM(itr != typeBuilderMap.end(),
                  << "no type builder has been registered for device: "
                  << device);
    return itr->second;
  }

  /// Register the given buffer builder for the given device.
  void registerBufferBuilder(DeviceRefAttr device,
                             std::unique_ptr<MGPBufferBuilder> bufferBuilder) {
    [[maybe_unused]] bool inserted =
        bufferBuilderMap.insert({device, std::move(bufferBuilder)}).second;
    ASSERT_STREAM(inserted,
                  << "a buffer builder has already been registered for device");
  }

  /// Returns the buffer builder to use for device. The builder is owned by
  /// this object.
  MGPBufferBuilder &getBufferBuilder(DeviceRefAttr device) const {
    assert(device);
    auto itr = bufferBuilderMap.find(device);
    ASSERT_STREAM(itr != bufferBuilderMap.end(),
                  << "no buffer builder has been registered for device "
                  << device);
    return *itr->second;
  }

  /// Returns the buffer builder to use for the 'host' device.
  MGPBufferBuilder &getHostBufferBuilder() const {
    return getBufferBuilder(hostDevice);
  }

private:
  llvm::DenseMap<DeviceRefAttr, MGPTypeBuilder> typeBuilderMap;

  llvm::DenseMap<DeviceRefAttr, std::unique_ptr<MGPBufferBuilder>>
      bufferBuilderMap;
};

} // namespace M::MGP

#endif // GENERICML_MGPDIALECT_BUFFERBUILDER_H

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// BufferConstantOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def MGP_ResourceConstantOp : MGP_Op<"resource.constant", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  Pure,
]> {
  let arguments = (ins IndexAttr:$resourceSlot);
  let results = (outs MGP_DeviceBufferType:$outBuffer);

  let summary = "Retrieves a pointer to the corresponding constant resources";
  let description = [{
    Retrieves a pointer to the constant resources attached to the parent
    `mogg.func`. Kernels differing only in constant values still merge
    when the index matches, which speeds up compilation.
  }];

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `(` operands `)` `resourceSlot` `=` $resourceSlot attr-dict
        `:` functional-type(operands, results)
  }];
}

def BufferConstantOp : MGP_Op<"buffer.constant", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MGP_LiftableBufferCreateOpInterface, ["isTrivial"]>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MGP_SelectiveLowerAttrOpInterface, [
    "getLiftableAttributes",
    "getIgnorableAttributes"
  ]>,
  InferTypeOpAdaptor,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Allocates and initializes a buffer from a host attribute.";
  let description = [{
    Returns an `!mgp.buffer` initialized with the byte array in the given attribute
    (which will be loaded from the MEFFile holding the compiled model).

    Example:
    ```mlir
      %buf = mgp.buffer.constant
               dense_resource<label>:!M.aligned_bytes<256, align 16>
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    ElementsAttr:$value,
    UI64Attr:$rawAlign
  );
  let results = (outs MGP_DeviceBufferType:$outBuffer);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    custom<ElementsAttrWithAlign>($value, $rawAlign) attr-dict
  }];
  let hasVerifier = 1;

  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    /// Returns the buffer's alignment.
    std::optional<uint64_t> getOptAlign();
  }];

  let builders = [
    OpBuilder<(ins "mlir::ElementsAttr":$value)>
  ];

  let extraClassDefinition = [{
    bool BufferConstantOp::isTrivial() { return true; }

    SmallVector<Attribute> BufferConstantOp::getLiftableAttributes() {
      return {getValueAttr()};
    }

    SmallVector<Attribute> BufferConstantOp::getIgnorableAttributes() {
      return {getRawAlignAttr()};
    }

  }];

}

def ContextCreateOp : MGP_Op<"context.create"> {
  let summary = "Creates a context with given number of state slots.";
  let description = [{
    Creates a context with the given number of 'state slots'.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %ctx = mgp.context.create 4
    %ctx : !mgp.context
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins UI64Attr:$numSlots);
  let results = (outs MGP_ContextType:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = "$numSlots attr-dict";
}


//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// TensorCreateOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def TensorCreateOp : MGP_Op<"tensor.create", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<GRTExtendsLifetimeInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<GRTMayAliasInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MGP_CreateTensorOpInterface>,
  InferTypeOpAdaptor,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Creates an `!mgp.tensor` from an `!mgp.tensor_spec` and "
                "`!mgp.buffer`.";
  let description = [{
    If this op holds the only reference to the buffer then it is moved into
    the tensor. Otherwise a deep copy of the buffer is taken.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %ctx : !mef.context
    %ch : !mef.chain
    %buf : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 3>>
    %spec : !mgp.tensor_spec<4x16xf32>
    %tensor = mgp.tensor.create %ch, %ctx[5], %buf, %spec : !mgp.tensor<4x16xf32, <"gpu", 3>>
    %tensor : !mgp.tensor<4x16xf32, <"gpu", 3>>
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    ChainType:$inChain,
    MGP_DeviceBufferType:$buffer,
    MGP_TensorSpecType:$tensorSpec,
    // Mirrors the `mut` marker on the result type: the type parameter is not
    // derivable from the operands, allowing the use of InferTypeOpAdaptor.
    UnitAttr:$mut,
    // Mirrors the `stable` marker on the result type.
    UnitAttr:$stable
  );
  let results = (outs MGP_DeviceTensorType:$outTensor);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $inChain `,` $buffer `,` $tensorSpec
    (`mut` $mut^)? (`stable` $stable^)? attr-dict
    `:` custom<TensorTypeToDeviceBufferSpec>(type($outTensor),
          type($buffer), type($tensorSpec), type($inChain))
  }];
  let hasVerifier = 1;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// TensorExtractBufferOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def TensorExtractBufferOp : MGP_Op<"tensor.extract.buffer", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<GRTExtendsLifetimeInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<GRTMayAliasInterface>,
  InferTypeOpAdaptor,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Extracts the `!mgp.buffer` from an `!mgp.tensor`.";
  let description = [{
    If this op holds the only reference to the tensor then the buffer will be
    moved out of the tensor. Otherwise a deep copy of the buffer is returned.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %tensor : !mgp.tensor<8x64xf32, <"gpu", 3>>
    %buf = mgp.tensor.extract.buffer %tensor : <8x64xf32, <"gpu", 3>>
    %buf : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 3>>
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins MGP_DeviceTensorType:$tensor);
  let results = (outs MGP_DeviceBufferType:$outBuffer);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $tensor attr-dict `:` type($tensor)
  }];
  let hasFolder = 1;
  let hasVerifier = 1;
}


//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// TensorExtractTensorSpecOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def TensorExtractTensorSpecOp : MGP_Op<"tensor.extract.tensor_spec", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  InferTypeOpAdaptor,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Extracts the `!mgp.tensor_spec` from a `!mgp.tensor`.";
  let description = [{
    Returns the `!mgp.tensor_spec` of a tensor. If requested, the dtype
    can be replaced with `unk` to represent the tensor's 'shape'.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %tensor : !mgp.tensor<8x64xf32, <"gpu", 3>>
    %shape0 = mgp.tensor.extract.tensor_spec %tensor : <8x64xf32, <"gpu", 3>>
    %shape0 : !mgp.tensor_spec<8x64xk32>
    %shape1 = mgp.tensor.extract.tensor_spec %tensor : <8x64xf32, <"gpu", 3>>
    %shape1 : !mgp.tensor_spec<8x64xunk>
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins MGP_DeviceTensorType:$tensor);
  let results = (outs MGP_TensorSpecType:$outSpec);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $tensor attr-dict `:` type($tensor)
  }];
  let hasVerifier = 1;
  let hasFolder = 1;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// TensorSliceOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def TensorSliceOp : MGP_Op<"tensor.slice", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<GRTExtendsLifetimeInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<GRTMayAliasInterface>,
  InferTypeOpAdaptor,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Zero-copy contiguous slice of a tensor along one dimension.";
  let description = [{
    Returns a view into the input tensor starting at the given offset. No data
    is copied; the output tensor borrows from the input. The sliced dimension
    k, the stride in elements, and the start offset are all computed at runtime
    inside the Mojo primitive from the input shape and the start buffer.

    The input tensor may reside on any device. The start tensor must be on the
    host (cpu) since it is metadata; no device data is read from it.

    The device context must be on the same device as the input; backends whose
    runtime only accepts registered pointers register the slice through it.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %input : !mgp.tensor<5xf32, <"gpu", 0>>
    %spec  : !mgp.tensor_spec<3xf32>
    %start : !mgp.tensor<1xsi64, <"cpu", 0>>
    %ctx   : !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
    %out = mgp.tensor.slice %input, %spec, %start, %ctx
             : !mgp.tensor<5xf32, <"gpu", 0>>, !mgp.tensor_spec<3xf32>,
               !mgp.tensor<1xsi64, <"cpu", 0>>,
               !mgp.device_context<<"gpu", 0>>
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    MGP_DeviceTensorType:$input,
    MGP_TensorSpecType:$outputSpec,
    MGP_DeviceTensorType:$start,
    MGP_DeviceContextType:$deviceContext
  );

  let results = (outs MGP_DeviceTensorType:$output);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $input `,` $outputSpec `,` $start `,` $deviceContext attr-dict `:`
    type($input) `,` type($outputSpec) `,` type($start) `,`
    qualified(type($deviceContext))
  }];

  let hasVerifier = 1;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// TensorSpecCreateOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def TensorSpecCreateOp : MGP_Op<"tensor_spec.create", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  InferTypeOpAdaptor,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = [{
    Creates a CPU tensor spec from a mix of runtime and static dimensions and
    a statically known dtype.
  ]};
  let description = [{
    Creates a CPU tensor spec of statically known rank with dimensions taken
    from either runtime operands or statically known attributes. The element
    type must be known statically. One operand is given per unknown dimension,
    in order (none if all dimensions are static).

    Tensor specs are represented as M::TensorSpecs in the Modular runtime.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %dim0 : index
    %dim1 : index

    %spec = mgp.tensor_spec.create %dim0, %dim1 : !mgp.tensor_spec<?x?xf32>
    %spec : !mgp.tensor_spec<?x?xf32>

    %spec = mgp.tensor_spec.create : !mgp.tensor_spec<32x4xf32>
    %spec : !mgp.tensor_spec<32x4xf32>
    ```
  }];

  // NOTE: The two attributes effectively encode the result's tensor spec type
  // in a form understandable by MEF.
  let arguments = (ins
    Variadic<Index>:$runtimeDims,
    UI64ArrayElementsAttr:$rawDims,
    UI8Attr:$rawDType
  );
  let results = (outs MGP_TensorSpecType:$result);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $runtimeDims attr-dict
    `:` custom<RawDimsAndDType>($rawDims, $rawDType)
  }];
  let hasVerifier = 1;

  let builders = [
    OpBuilder<(ins
      "TensorSpecType":$spec,
      CArg<"ValueRange", "{}">:$runtimeDims
    )>
  ];
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// TensorSpecGetDimOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def TensorSpecGetDimOp : MGP_Op<"tensor_spec.get_dim", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<InferTypeOpInterface>,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = [{
    Return the dimension of the tensor_spec at the specified axis.
  ]};
  let description = [{
    Returns the actual runtime value of each dimension in a CPU tensor spec.
    If the dimension is known statically, it is returned as a constant index.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    MGP_TensorSpecType:$spec,
    UI64Attr:$axis
  );
  let results = (outs Index:$dim);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    `[` $axis `]` $spec attr-dict `:` type($spec)
  }];
  let hasVerifier = 1;
  let hasFolder = 1;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// AssertOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def AssertOp : MGP_Op<"assert", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface, ["isThrows"]>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MGP_LiftableChainCreateOpInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MGP_SelectiveLowerAttrOpInterface, ["getLiftableAttributes"]>,
]> {
  let summary = "Assert that a boolean condition is true.";
  let description = [{
    Return an error with the given message if the condition is false.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %ch = mgp.assert %cond, "condition is not true"
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins I1:$cond, StrAttr:$message);
  let results = (outs ChainType:$outChain);
  let assemblyFormat = "$cond `,` $message attr-dict";
  let hasCanonicalizeMethod = 1;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// ExecuteGenericOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def ExecuteGenericOp : MGP_Op<"generic.execute"> {
  let summary = "Executes a function loaded into the CPU Runtime";
  let description = [{
    Executes a function already loaded into the compiled kernel context at the
    given slot/module index within the `!mgp.context`, using the generic API:
    the primitive passes raw async values for the function to unpack.

    Always returns an output chain in addition to the kernel results, for error
    handling or side-effect dependencies.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    MGP_ContextType:$theContext,
    Variadic<AnyType>:$args,
    UI64Attr:$aRuntimeSlot,  // 0
    UI64Attr:$bModuleIndex,  // 1
    UI64Attr:$cFunctionIndex,  // 2
    StrAttr:$dSummary,  // 3
    DefaultValuedAttr<BoolAttr, "false">:$eIsAsync,  // 4
    ArrayAttr:$fConstantResource  // 5
  );
  let results = (outs Variadic<AnyType>:$outResults);
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// GuardOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def GuardOp : MGP_Op<"guard", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<GRTMayAliasInterface>,
  InferTypeOpAdaptor,
]> {
  let summary = "SSA-value guard operation";

  let description = [{
    Consumes a chain and a variadic list of values and forwards the non-chain
    inputs, establishing execution dependencies between the chain-producing op
    and downstream operations.

    Example:

    ```mlir
      %X: !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>
      %Y: !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>

      %spec1_1 = mgp.tensor_spec.get_dim[1] %0 : !mgp.tensor_spec<?x?xf32>
      %spec2_0 = mgp.tensor_spec.get_dim[0] %2 : !mgp.tensor_spec<?x?xf32>

      %cond = index.cmp.eq %spec1_1, %spec2_0

      %chain = mgp.assert %cond, "D1 != D2"
      %Xp, %Yp = mgp.guard %chain, %X, %Y : !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>, !mgp.tensor<?x?xf32>
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    ChainType:$chain,
    Variadic<AnyType>:$inputs
  );
  let results = (outs Variadic<AnyType>:$results);

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    ` ` operands ` ` attr-dict `:` qualified(type($inputs))
  }];

  let hasVerifier = 1;
}


def ExtendLifetimeOp : MGP_Op<"extend.lifetime", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MGP_LiftableChainCreateOpInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "SSA-value guard operation";

  let description = [{
    Returns a chain that is ready when all inputs are, extending the lifetime
    of the input values to match the lifetime of the input chain.
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    ChainType:$gate,
    Variadic<AnyType>:$inputs
  );
  let results = (outs ChainType:$results);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    ` ` operands ` ` attr-dict `:` functional-type(operands, results)
  }];
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// ModelOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def ModelFrameworkAttr : ConfinedAttr<StrAttr, [
  AttrConstraint<
    CPred<"CompiledFrameworkLabel::isValidFrameworkName("
          "cast<StringAttr>($_self).getValue())">,
    "must be a recognized framework name.">,
]>;

def ModelOp : MGP_Op<"model", [
  HasOnlyGraphRegion,
  HasParent<"ModuleOp">,
  IsolatedFromAbove,
  RegionKindInterface,
  SymbolName,
  SymbolVisibility,
  Symbol,
]> {
  let summary = [{
    Represents an executable model with 'init' and 'execute' entry points.
  }];
  let description = [{
    The 'init' and 'execute' entry points are single-block regions.

    The 'init' entry point has the implicit signature:
      (!mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>, ...) ->
      (!mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>, ...)
    where:
      mgp.opaques are the weights registry and device contexts.

    The 'execute' entry point has the implicit signature:
      (!mef.chain, !mgp.context, weights_registry, dev0, ... devn, in1, ..., inn) ->
      (!mef.chain, res1, ..., resm)
    where:
      (in1, ..., inn) -> (res1, ..., resm)
    is the op's explicit signature, and weights_registry and dev0, ..., devn
    are those passed to init.

    The Modular runtime implicitly calls 'init' when the model executable is
    first loaded, and re-uses the resulting context value for each subsequent
    call to 'execute'.

    This op is represented by a subclass of M::Model in the Modular runtime,
    chosen by the `frameworkName` attribute, which tools inspect to decide
    which API mediates between framework-specific values and the model's.

    Additional attributes may be supplied; these names have special meaning:
     - argument_names
     - result_names

    Example:
    ```mlir
    // At the top-level
    mgp.model @example_model : mof { attr="value" }
      init (%weights: !mgp.opaque<"weights_registry">, %cpu: !mgp.device_context<<"cpu", 0>>) {
        %ch = mef.chain.new
        %ctx = mgp.context.create 0
        mef.output %ch, %ctx, %weights, %cpu : !mef.chain, !mgp.context, !mgp.opaque, !mgp.opaque
      }
      execute (%ch: !mef.chain, %ctx: !mgp.context, %weights: !mgp.opaque, %cpu: mgp.opaque, %arg: tensor<?x4x16xf32>)
              -> (!mef.chain, tensor<?x10xf32>) {
        mef.output %ch, %arg : !mef.chain, tensor<?x4x16xf32>
      }
    ```
  }];

  // CAUTION: Constraints on these attribute names and their order:
  //  - 'sym_name' must match mlir::SymbolTable::getSymbolAttrName().
  //  - The extra attributes must appear last since optional.
  let arguments = (ins
    M_DeviceRefArrayAttr:$devices,
    ModelFrameworkAttr:$frameworkName,
    TypeAttrOf<FunctionType>:$inputOutputTypes,
    SymbolNameAttr:$sym_name,
    OptionalAttr<StrAttr>:$sym_visibility,
    UnitAttr:$isSubgraph,
    UnitAttr:$isDeviceGraph,
    OptionalAttr<DictionaryAttr>:$theExtraAttrs
  );

  let regions = (region SizedRegion<1>:$init, SizedRegion<1>:$execute);

  let extraClassDeclaration = [{
    Block *getInitBlock() { return &getInit().front(); }
    Block *getExecuteBlock() { return &getExecute().front(); }

    /// Required by the internal callgraph utilities.
    Region &getBodyRegion() { return getExecute(); }

    MutableArrayRef<BlockArgument> getInitDevices() {
      return getInitBlock()->getArguments().drop_front(kMgpModelNumFixedImplicitInitArgs).take_front(getDevices().size());
    }
    OperandRange getInitOutputDevices() {
      return getInitBlock()->getTerminator()->getOperands().drop_front(
        // Fixed implicit execute args are also fixed implicit init output args.
        kMgpModelNumFixedImplicitExecArgs
      ).take_front(getDevices().size());
    }

    BlockArgument getInitWeightsRegistry() {
      return getInitBlock()->getArgument(0);
    }

    MutableArrayRef<BlockArgument> getExecuteInputs() {
      return getExecuteBlock()->getArguments().drop_front(kMgpModelNumFixedImplicitExecArgs + getDevices().size());
    }
    MutableArrayRef<BlockArgument> getExecuteChainContext() {
      return getExecuteBlock()->getArguments().take_front(2);
    }
    MutableArrayRef<BlockArgument> getExecuteDevices() {
      return getExecuteBlock()->getArguments().drop_front(kMgpModelNumFixedImplicitExecArgs).take_front(getDevices().size());
    }
    MutableArrayRef<BlockArgument> getExecuteImplicitArguments() {
      return getExecuteBlock()->getArguments().take_front(kMgpModelNumFixedImplicitExecArgs + getDevices().size());
    }
    BlockArgument getExecuteChain() { return getExecuteBlock()->getArgument(0); }
    BlockArgument getExecuteWeightsRegistry() { return getExecuteBlock()->getArgument(2); }
    BlockArgument getSubgraphIndex() { return getExecuteBlock()->getArguments().back(); }

    /// Retrieve the single ContextCreateOp from the init block.
    ContextCreateOp getInitContext();

    /// Retrieve the context for the execute block.
    TypedValue<MGP::ContextType> getExecuteContext();


    StringAttr getName() { return getSymNameAttr(); }
  }];

  let builders = [
    /// Creates a model with empty 'init' and 'execute' bodies and explicit
    /// signature `inputTypes` -> `outputTypes`. `inputArgLocs` gives the
    /// locations of the explicit 'execute' arguments, one per input type.
    OpBuilder<(ins
      "StringAttr":$sym_name,
      "StringRef":$frameworkName,
      "ArrayRef<DeviceRef>":$devices,
      "ArrayRef<Type>":$inputTypes,
      "ArrayRef<Type>":$outputTypes,
      "ArrayRef<Location>":$inputArgLocs,
      CArg<"bool", "false">:$isSubgraph,
      CArg<"bool", "false">:$isDeviceGraph,
      CArg<"ArrayRef<NamedAttribute>", "{}">:$extraAttrs
    )>
  ];

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    custom<SymbolVisibility>($sym_visibility) `` $sym_name
      (`subgraph` $isSubgraph^)? (`device_graph` $isDeviceGraph^)?
      `:` custom<ClassName>($frameworkName)
      ($theExtraAttrs^)?
      `devices` $devices
      `init` custom<InitRegion>($init)
      `execute` custom<ExecuteRegion>($inputOutputTypes, $execute, ref($devices))
      attr-dict
  }];
  let hasRegionVerifier = 1;
  let hasVerifier = 1;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// RuntimeCreateOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def RuntimeCreateOp : MGP_Op<"runtime.create", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<MGP_HasRuntimeSlotOpInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Creates a runtime to coordinate execution.";
  let description = [{
    Creates a runtime within an `!mgp.context` slot.

    Note that this operation accepts and returns `!mef.chain`s since it is
    part of device setup on the host.

    Example:
    ```mlir
      // Establish a runtime in slot 5.
      %ch0 : !mef.chain
      %ctx : !mgp.context
      %ch1 = mgp.runtime.create %ch0, %ctx[5]
      %ch1 : !mef.chain
    ```
  }];

  // CAUTION: The attribute arguments must be in alphabetical order by their
  // names.
  let arguments = (ins
    ChainType:$inChain,
    MGP_ContextType:$theContext,
    UI64Attr:$aRuntimeSlot  // 1
  );
  let results = (outs ChainType:$outChain);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $inChain `,` $theContext `[` $aRuntimeSlot `]` attr-dict
  }];

  let extraClassDefinition = [{
    uint64_t RuntimeCreateOp::getSlot() { return getARuntimeSlot(); }

  }];
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// BufferGetCachedOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def BufferGetCachedOp : MGP_Op<"buffer.get_cached", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  Pure,
]> {
  let summary = "Retrieves an `!mgp.buffer` from a dedicated state slot.";
  let description = [{
    Returns (a borrow of) the `!mgp.buffer` in the state slot with the given
    index. The buffer should have already been cached by `mgp.buffer.cache`.
    Returns an error if the cached buffer's size (if any) or device do not
    agree with the `!mgp.buffer` type annotation.

    Note this op is gated by a `!mef.chain` since the cache is held on the
    host.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %ctx : !mgp.context
    %ch0 : !mef.chain
    %idx : index
    // Returns the buffer cached in slot index.
    %buf = mgp.buffer.get_cached %ch0, %ctx[%idx] : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 3>>
    %buf : !mgp.buffer<<"gpu", 3>>
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    ChainType:$inChain,
    MGP_ContextType:$theContext,
    Index:$bBufferSlot  // 1
  );

  let results = (outs
    MGP_DeviceBufferType:$outBuffer,
    Optional<PointerOf<PointerOf<KGEN_NoneType>>>:$optional_memStorageHandle
  );

  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $inChain `,` $theContext `[` $bBufferSlot `]` attr-dict
    `:` qualified(type($outBuffer)) (`,` qualified(type($optional_memStorageHandle))^)?
  }];

  let hasCanonicalizeMethod = 1;
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// IntCacheOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

def IntCacheOp : MGP_Op<"int.cache", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Stores an integer value into a dedicated state slot.";
  let description = [{
    Stores the given integer value into the state slot at the given index.
    It may be later retrieved by `mgp.int.get_cached`.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %ctx : !mgp.context
    %val : index
    %ch0 : !mef.chain
    // Cache the integer in slot 42.
    %ch1 = mgp.int.cache %ch0, %ctx[42], %val
    ```
  }];

  let arguments = (ins
    ChainType:$inChain,
    MGP_ContextType:$theContext,
    Index:$value,
    UI64Attr:$bIntSlot
  );
  let results = (outs ChainType:$outChain);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $inChain `,` $theContext `[` $bIntSlot `]` `,` $value attr-dict
  }];
}

def IntGetCachedOp : MGP_Op<"int.get_cached", [

  }];

def BufferGetSizeOp : MGP_Op<"buffer.get_size", [
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<EmitsMojoInterface>,
  DeclareOpInterfaceMethods<InferTypeOpInterface>,
]> {
  let summary = "Get the runtime size of a buffer in bytes.";

    Returns the size of the input buffer in bytes.

  }];

    If a label attribute is supplied the string is printed with that label.

    Note this op accepts and returns `!mef.chain`s since printing is managed
    by the host.

    Example:
    ```mlir
    %ch0: !mef.chain
    ```

  let arguments = (ins
    ChainType:$inChain,
    MGP_ContextType:$theContext,
    StrAttr:$debugString,
    DefaultValuedAttr<StrAttr, "\"\"">:$label
  );
  let results = (outs ChainType:$outChain);
  let assemblyFormat = [{
    $inChain `,` $theContext `,` $debugString ( `,` $label^ )? attr-dict
  }];
}
