// mgp.generic.execute
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Packs pointers to the input and output async values (then the constant
/// resources) into the array the kernel ABI expects.
template <typename OperandTy, typename ResultTy>
llvm::SmallVector<void *> getKernelInputs(OperandTy &operands,
                                          ResultTy &results,
                                          MEFListAttr constantResources) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("getKernelInputs", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  llvm::SmallVector<void *> kernelInputs;
  kernelInputs.reserve(results.size() + operands.size() +
                       constantResources.size());

  auto appendInput = [&kernelInputs](const AnyAsyncValueRef &ref) {
    kernelInputs.push_back(
        const_cast<void *>(reinterpret_cast<const void *>(&ref)));
  };

  for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &res : operands)
    appendInput(res);
  for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &res : results)
    appendInput(res);

  for (MEFDynamicAttr attr : constantResources) {
    kernelInputs.push_back(
        const_cast<void *>(reinterpret_cast<const void *>(attr.get())));

    size_t byteCount = 1;
    if (attr.getAttrKind() == MEF::AttributeKind::kString) {
      byteCount = M::decodeMEFArrayLength(attr.get());
    } else if (((uint8_t)attr.getAttrKind()) &
               ((uint8_t)MEF::AttributeKind::mArrayType)) {
      byteCount = M::decodeMEFArrayLength(attr.get()) *
                  M::MEF::getWidthInBits(attr.getAttrKind()) / 8;
    } else {
      ASSERT_STREAM(attr.getAttrKind() != MEF::AttributeKind::kBool &&
                        attr.getAttrKind() != MEF::AttributeKind::kDictionary &&
                        attr.getAttrKind() != MEF::AttributeKind::kList &&
                        attr.getAttrKind() != MEF::AttributeKind::kType &&
                        attr.getAttrKind() != MEF::AttributeKind::kSymbolRef,
                    "unhandled type of resources.");
    }
    kernelInputs.push_back(reinterpret_cast<void *>(byteCount));
  }

  return kernelInputs;
}

/// Returns the accelerator device all operand device contexts share, and one
/// such context for pinning; otherwise kNoDevicePreference and null.
static std::pair<int, M::Driver::DeviceContextRef>
deviceHintAndContextFor(const RemainingArguments &operands) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("deviceHintAndContextFor", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  llvm::SmallVector<M::Driver::DeviceContextRef, 8> acceleratorContexts;

  for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &operand : operands) {
    if (operand.isType<M::Driver::DeviceContextRef>()) {
      const auto &deviceCtxRef =
          *static_cast<const M::Driver::DeviceContextRef *>(
              operand.getPointerToData());
      if (deviceCtxRef->device().api() != M::Driver::Device::cpuAPI) {
        acceleratorContexts.push_back(
            M::Driver::DeviceContextRef::copy(deviceCtxRef.getPointer()));
      }
    }
  }

  // Several contexts on one device occur in side-stream regions (the
  // side-stream view plus its base context); the task still belongs on that
  // device's worker.
  if (!acceleratorContexts.empty()) {
    int deviceId = acceleratorContexts.front()->device().id();
    if (llvm::all_of(acceleratorContexts, [&](const auto &ctx) {
          return ctx->device().id() == deviceId;
        }))
      return {deviceId, std::move(acceleratorContexts.front())};
  }
  return {kNoDevicePreference, M::Driver::DeviceContextRef{}};
}

static void
mgp_generic_execute(StateContext &ctx, RemainingArguments operands,
                    RemainingResults outResults, MEFAttr<uint64_t> aSlot,
                    MEFAttr<uint64_t> bModuleIndex,
                    MEFAttr<uint64_t> cFunctionIndex,
                    MEFAttr<StringRef> dSummary, MEFAttr<bool> eIsAsync,
                    MEFListAttr fConstantResources, CPUDevice &cpuDevice) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NCT("mgp_generic_execute", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL,
                        "(Summary: " + dSummary.get().str() + ")");

  M::MGP::KernelExecutionState &kernelExecutionState =
      ctx.getStateSlotPayload<M::MGP::KernelExecutionState>(
          static_cast<size_t>(*aSlot));
  CompiledKernelAsyncABIFn *kernelPtr = kernelExecutionState.getKernelAsyncABI(
      static_cast<size_t>(*bModuleIndex), static_cast<size_t>(*cFunctionIndex));

  // deviceCtx is non-null only when deviceHint != kNoDevicePreference.
  auto [deviceHint, deviceCtx] = deviceHintAndContextFor(operands);

  AsyncRT::WorkQueue *workQueue = cpuDevice.getWorkQueue();
  int taskId =
      (deviceHint == kNoDevicePreference)
          ? kDefaultTaskId
          : MLRT::taskIdForDevice(deviceHint, workQueue->getParallelismLevel());

  // Async kernels always run out of line. Sync kernels run inline unless they
  // have task affinity and this is the wrong worker.
  if (eIsAsync.get() || !workQueue->shouldRunInlineForTask(taskId)) {
    TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NCT("-> mgp_generic_execute (async)", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL,
                          "(Summary: " + dSummary.get().str() + ")");

    // GraphRT expects allocated results; only needed here because the task
    // outlives this function.
    outResults.allocateIndirectResults();

    // Captures keep the inputs, outputs, and pinned device context alive until
    // the kernel completes.
    auto runKernelAndExtendLifetimes =
        [outResults = outResults.copyAsVector(),
         takenOperands = operands.takeAsVector(),
         constantResources = std::move(fConstantResources), kernelPtr, dSummary,
         deviceCtx = std::move(deviceCtx)]() mutable {
          TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NCT("runKernelAndExtendLifetimes", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL,
                                "(Summary: " + dSummary.get().str() + ")");

          // Results are published into `outResults` as the task's last action
          // so no downstream work starts before `kernelPtr` fully completes.
          llvm::SmallVector<AnyAsyncValueRef> localResults(outResults.size());

          llvm::SmallVector<void *> kernelInputs =
              getKernelInputs(takenOperands, localResults, constantResources);
          MAYBE_LOG_ASYNC_KERNEL(*dSummary, takenOperands, localResults);

          if (deviceCtx.getPointer() != nullptr)
            (void)deviceCtx->bindToCurrentThread();

          {
            TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NCT("Invoke Mojo function", TRACY_COLOR_ORANGE,
                                  "(Summary: " + dSummary.get().str() + ")");
            kernelPtr(reinterpret_cast<void **>(kernelInputs.data()));
          }

          if (deviceCtx.getPointer() != nullptr)
            M::Driver::DeviceContext::unbindFromCurrentThread();

          // Must have all been released/reset by the compiled kernel.
          assert(llvm::all_of(takenOperands, [](const AnyAsyncValueRef &ref) {
            return !ref.getPointer();
          }));

          // Release everything context-reachable BEFORE the driver can observe
          // completion: operand slots (already reset by the kernel) and the
          // pinned device context reference.
          takenOperands.clear();
          deviceCtx = M::Driver::DeviceContextRef();

          for (const auto &[local, output] :
               llvm::zip_equal(localResults, outResults)) {
            assert(local && "compiled kernel did not fulfill a result slot");
            std::move(output).resolveIndirect(std::move(local));
          }
        };

    AsyncRT::WorkItem workItem(std::move(runKernelAndExtendLifetimes));
    workQueue->addTask(std::move(workItem), taskId);
  } else {
    TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NCT("-> mgp_generic_execute (sync kernel)",
                          TRACY_COLOR_TEAL,
                          "(Summary: " + dSummary.get().str() + ")");

    if (deviceCtx.getPointer() != nullptr)
      (void)deviceCtx->bindToCurrentThread();

    llvm::SmallVector<void *> kernelInputs =
        getKernelInputs(operands, outResults, fConstantResources);
    MAYBE_LOG_SYNC_KERNEL(*dSummary, operands, outResults.get());
    {
      TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NCT("Invoke Mojo function", TRACY_COLOR_ORANGE,
                            "(Summary: " + dSummary.get().str() + ")");

      kernelPtr(reinterpret_cast<void **>(kernelInputs.data()));
    }

    if (deviceCtx.getPointer() != nullptr)
      M::Driver::DeviceContext::unbindFromCurrentThread();

    // Must have all been released/reset by the compiled kernel.
    assert(llvm::all_of(operands, [](const AnyAsyncValueRef &ref) {
      return !ref.getPointer();
    }));
  }
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.device_graph.execute
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Returns the data pointer and byte size of a graph input operand, or nullopt
/// for context operands.
///
/// Must stay in step with `DeviceGraphCollectiveCreateOp::emitMojo`, which
/// picks the operands that get an `add_input` stable location, or inputs pair
/// with the wrong stable buffers.
static std::optional<std::pair<void *, size_t>>
graphInputData(const AnyAsyncValueRef &operand) {
  if (auto *tensor = dyn_cast<MLRT::Tensor>(operand))
    return std::pair{tensor->getMutableBuffer(), tensor->getSizeInBytes()};
  if (auto *buffer = dyn_cast<TensorBufferRef>(operand))
    return std::pair{buffer->getBuffer(), buffer->getSize()};
  return std::nullopt;
}

/// Copies the live `inputs` into `graph`'s stable input buffers. `inputs` must
/// be exactly this graph's slice of the operands.
static M::ErrorOrSuccess
copyDeviceGraphInputs(M::Driver::DeviceGraph &graph,
                      ArrayRef<AnyAsyncValueRef> inputs) {
  ArrayRef<M::Driver::DeviceBufferRef> stableInputs = graph.getInputs();
  if (stableInputs.empty())
    return M::success();

  size_t inputIdx = 0;
  for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &operand : inputs) {
    std::optional<std::pair<void *, size_t>> data = graphInputData(operand);
    if (!data)
      continue;

    if (inputIdx >= stableInputs.size())
      return Error("device graph input count mismatch");

    if (!stableInputs[inputIdx]) {
      ++inputIdx;
      continue;
    }

    M::Driver::DeviceBuffer &dst = *stableInputs[inputIdx++];
    auto [srcPtr, srcSize] = *data;

    M::Driver::DeviceContextRef ctx =
        M::Driver::DeviceContextRef::copy(&dst.context());
    M::Driver::DeviceBufferRef srcView =
        dst.isHost() ? ctx->createHostBufferOwning(srcPtr, srcSize,
                                                   /*owning=*/false)
                     : ctx->createBufferOwning(srcPtr, srcSize,
                                               /*owning=*/false);

    if (ErrorOrSuccess err = srcView->copyTo(dst))
      return err.takeError();
  }

  if (inputIdx != stableInputs.size())
    return Error("device graph input count mismatch");
  return M::success();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.device_graph.collective.execute
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Writes every stable address slot the `graphs` publish into, and waits for
/// the writes to land. A slot published by one device's graph is read by
/// another device's graph as soon as that graph launches, and nothing orders
/// the two streams, so every slot write must complete before any graph in the
/// collective starts.
static M::ErrorOrSuccess
patchCollectiveStableAddresses(ArrayRef<M::Driver::DeviceGraph *> graphs) {
  llvm::SmallVector<M::Driver::DeviceContext *, 8> patchedContexts;
  patchedContexts.reserve(graphs.size());

  for (M::Driver::DeviceGraph *graph : graphs) {
    if (graph->getStableAssignments().empty())
      continue;
    if (M::ErrorOrSuccess err = graph->patchStableAddresses())
      return err;
    patchedContexts.push_back(&graph->context());
  }

  for (M::Driver::DeviceContext *ctx : patchedContexts)
    if (M::ErrorOrSuccess err = ctx->synchronize())
      return err;
  return M::success();
}

// Replays the graphs built by `mgp.device_graph.collective.create`. Operands
// are the per-device `DeviceGraphRef`s, then every graph's live inputs in graph
// order; each graph's recorded signature sets how many it consumes.
static void mgp_device_graph_collective_execute(RemainingArguments operands,
                                                Result<Chain> outChain,
                                                RemainingResults outputs,
                                                EncodedLocation loc) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_device_graph_collective_execute", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  SmallVector<M::Driver::DeviceGraph *, 8> graphs;

  for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &operand : operands) {
    RCRef<M::Driver::DeviceGraph> *graph =
        dyn_cast<M::Driver::DeviceGraphRef>(operand);
    if (!graph)
      break;

    graphs.push_back(graph->getPointer());
  }

  MutableArrayRef<AnyAsyncValueRef> remainingInputs =
      operands.get().slice(graphs.size());

  outputs.allocateIndirectResults();

  auto fail = [&](Error msg) {
    std::move(outChain).setToError(msg.copy());
    std::move(outputs).setAllToError(std::move(msg), loc);
  };

  // Slots first, so the writes have landed before any graph launches.
  if (M::ErrorOrSuccess err = patchCollectiveStableAddresses(graphs))
    return fail(err.takeError());

  size_t inputOffset = 0;
  size_t outputIdx = 0;

  for (M::Driver::DeviceGraph *graph : graphs) {
    // The operand list carries every value the graph's region captured, so
    // non-input values (`!mgp.context`, scalars) ride along between the data
    // operands. The graph's stable-slot count only counts data operands, so
    // grow this graph's window until it holds that many, carrying the riders
    // for `copyDeviceGraphInputs` to skip.
    size_t numStableInputs = graph->getInputs().size();
    size_t numDataInputs = 0;
    size_t windowEnd = inputOffset;
    while (numDataInputs < numStableInputs) {
      if (windowEnd == remainingInputs.size())
        return fail("device graph collective execute: input operand count "
                    "does not match graph signatures");
      if (graphInputData(remainingInputs[windowEnd]))
        ++numDataInputs;
      ++windowEnd;
    }

    ArrayRef<AnyAsyncValueRef> graphInputs =
        remainingInputs.slice(inputOffset, windowEnd - inputOffset);

    if (M::ErrorOrSuccess err = copyDeviceGraphInputs(*graph, graphInputs))
      return fail(err.takeError());

    inputOffset = windowEnd;

    if (ErrorOrSuccess err = graph->replay())
      return fail(err.takeError());

    ArrayRef<AnyAsyncValueRef> graphOutputs = graph->getOutputs();
    if (outputIdx + graphOutputs.size() > outputs.size())
      return fail("device graph collective execute: output count does not "
                  "match graph signatures");

    for (const AnyAsyncValueRef &graphOutput : graphOutputs) {
      AnyAsyncValueRef &out = outputs[outputIdx++];
      out.copy().resolveIndirect(graphOutput.copy());
    }
  }

  if (outputIdx != outputs.size())
    return fail("device graph collective execute: output count does not "
                "match graph signatures");

  std::move(outChain).emplace();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.list.append
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_list_append(List &inputList, AnyAsyncValueRef element,
                            Result<List> output) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_list_append", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  if (element.isType<Tensor>()) {
    if (!inputList.getElements().empty() &&
        inputList.getElements().front().getValue().getPointer()->getTypeID() !=
            element.getPointer()->getTypeID()) {
      std::move(output).setToError("Tensor must be from the same device");
      return;
    }
  }

  List newList = inputList.copy();
  newList.getElements().push_back(element.copy());
  std::move(output).emplace(std::move(newList));
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.list.concat
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_list_concat(List &lhs, List &rhs, Result<List> output) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_list_concat", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  List resultList = lhs.copy();
  resultList.getElements().insert(resultList.getElements().end(),
                                  rhs.getElements().begin(),
                                  rhs.getElements().end());

  std::move(output).emplace(std::move(resultList));
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.list.create
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_list_create(RemainingArguments operands,
                            Result<List> outputList) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_list_create", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  std::move(outputList).emplace(List{operands.copyAsVector()});
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.list.get
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_list_get(List &inputList, Tensor &idxTensor,
                         RemainingResults outputs, EncodedLocation loc) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_list_get", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  // We must unbox the index value from the tensor.
  // TODO: Should be ssize_t.
  idxTensor.getEltType()
      .dispatch<void>(idxTensor.getBuffer())
      .template when<DType::si32, DType::si64>([&](auto *idxDataPtr) {
        auto idx = *idxDataPtr;

        int64_t listSize = inputList.getElements().size();
        if (idx < -listSize || listSize <= idx) {
          return std::move(outputs).setAllToError(
              Twine("index ") + Twine(idx) +
                  " is out of bound for list of size " + Twine(listSize),
              loc);
        }

        if (idx < 0)
          idx += listSize;

        // Elements have arbitrary types, so no typed `Result<...>`; sharing
        // the `AsyncValueRef` also avoids deep-copying values like `Tensor`.
        *outputs.begin() = inputList.getElements()[idx].getValue().copy();
      });
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.list.insert
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_list_insert(List &inputList, AnyAsyncValueRef element,
                            Tensor &idxTensor, Result<List> output) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_list_insert", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  // We must unbox the index value from the tensor.
  // TODO: Should be ssize_t.
  idxTensor.getEltType()
      .dispatch<void>(idxTensor.getBuffer())
      .template when<DType::si32, DType::si64>([&](auto *idxDataPtr) {
        auto idx = *idxDataPtr;

        int64_t listSize = inputList.getElements().size();
        if (idx < -listSize || listSize < idx) {
          return std::move(output).setToError(
              Twine("index ") + Twine(idx) +
              " is out of bound for list of size " + Twine(listSize));
        }

        if (idx < 0)
          idx += listSize;

        List newList = inputList.copy();
        newList.getElements().insert(newList.getElements().begin() + idx,
                                     element.copy());
        std::move(output).emplace(std::move(newList));
      });
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.list.slice
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_list_slice(List &inputList, Tensor &startTensor,
                           Tensor &endTensor, Tensor &stepTensor,
                           Result<List> output) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_list_slice", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  auto sliceFunctor = [&](auto start, auto end, auto step) {
    List resultList;

    auto &elems = inputList.getElements();

    ssize_t length = elems.size();

    if (step == 0) {
      return std::move(output).setToError(
          "The slice step argument must be a non-zero");
    }

    const bool stepIsPositive = step > 0;

    if (start < 0) {
      start += length;
    }
    if (end < 0) {
      end += length;
    }

    if (stepIsPositive) {
      start = std::clamp<decltype(start)>(start, 0, length - 1);
      end = std::clamp<decltype(end)>(end, 0, length);
    } else {
      start = std::clamp<decltype(start)>(start, 0, length - 1);
      end = std::clamp<decltype(end)>(end, -1, length);
    }

    if (stepIsPositive) {
      for (ssize_t i = start; i < end && i < length && i >= 0; i += step) {
        resultList.getElements().push_back(inputList.getElements()[i]);
      }
    } else {
      for (ssize_t i = start; i > end; i += step) {
        resultList.getElements().push_back(inputList.getElements()[i]);
      }
    }

    std::move(output).emplace(std::move(resultList));
  };

  startTensor.getEltType()
      .dispatch<void>(startTensor.getBuffer())
      .template when<DType::si32, DType::si64>([&](auto *startDataPtr) {
        auto start = *startDataPtr;

        endTensor.getEltType()
            .dispatch<void>(endTensor.getBuffer())
            .template when<DType::si32, DType::si64>([&](auto *endDataPtr) {
              auto end = *endDataPtr;

              stepTensor.getEltType()
                  .dispatch<void>(stepTensor.getBuffer())
                  .template when<DType::si32, DType::si64>(
                      [&](auto *stepDataPtr) {
                        auto step = *stepDataPtr;
                        sliceFunctor(start, end, step);
                      });
            });
      });
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.guard
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_guard(Chain inChain, RemainingArguments inputs,
                      RemainingResults results) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_guard", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  assert(inputs.size() == results.size());

  auto inputAsyncVals = inputs.get();
  auto resultAsyncVals = results.get();

  for (const auto &[input, result] :
       llvm::zip(inputAsyncVals, resultAsyncVals)) {
    result = std::move(input);
  }
}

static void mgp_model() {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_model", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  ASSERT_STREAM(false, << "mgp.model should never be invoked");
}

// Runs once all operands are ready, keeping them alive until then.
static void mgp_nop(RemainingArguments operands, Result<Chain> outChain) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_nop", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  std::move(outChain).emplace();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.runtime.create
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

void mgp_runtime_create(Chain inChain, StateContext &theContext,
                        Result<Chain> outChain, MEFAttr<uint64_t> aRuntimeSlot,
                        CPUDevice &cpuDevice) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_runtime_create", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  // M::Context is not in the primitive invocation ABI; callers (engine, mt,
  // mo-opt) create it and it is retrieved here.
  M::ContextRef ctxRef = Init::getContext();

  // One execution engine is shared by all models using this cpuDevice.
  //
  // TODO(#30647): Currently there's no garbage collection of dylibs loaded into
  //               this engine.
  ErrorOr<KGEN::ExecutionEngine *> engineOr =
      ctxRef->createIfMissing<KGEN::ExecutionEngine>(
          [&]() -> ErrorOr<std::unique_ptr<KGEN::ExecutionEngine>> {
            llvm::InitializeNativeTarget();
            llvm::InitializeNativeTargetAsmParser();
            llvm::InitializeNativeTargetAsmPrinter();
            auto targetMachineOr = getTargetMachineForHost();
            if (targetMachineOr.isError())
              return targetMachineOr.takeError();

            auto cfgOr = KGEN::MojoConfig::open();
            if (cfgOr.isError())
              return cfgOr.takeError();
            KGEN::MojoConfig cfg = std::move(*cfgOr);

            KGEN::ExecutionEngineOptions options;
            options.registerPerfPlugins =
                cpuDevice.getProfilerDebuginfo() ==
                M::AsyncRT::CPUDeviceOptions::ProfilerDebuginfo::kPerfProfiler;
            options.libraryPaths.push_back(cfg.getMGPRTPath());
            return KGEN::ExecutionEngine::createWithStandardLayers(
                std::move(options), **targetMachineOr);
          });

  if (engineOr.isError())
    return std::move(outChain).setToError(engineOr.takeError());

  theContext.emplaceStateSlot<KernelExecutionState>(
      static_cast<size_t>(*aRuntimeSlot), *engineOr);

  std::move(outChain).emplace();
}

// mgp.device_context.select_stream
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static ErrorOr<M::Driver::DeviceContextRef>
mgp_device_context_select_stream(M::Driver::DeviceContextRef &deviceContext,
                                 MEFAttr<uint64_t> streamId) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_device_context_select_stream", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);
  return deviceContext->selectStream(static_cast<unsigned>(*streamId));
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// mgp.buffer.cache
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

static void mgp_buffer_cache(Chain inChain, StateContext &theContext,
                             AsyncValueRef<TensorBufferRef> buffer,
                             Result<Chain> outChain,
                             MEFAttr<uint64_t> bBufferSlot,
                             CPUDevice &cpuDevice) {
  TRACY_ZONE_SCOPED_NC("mgp_buffer_cache", TRACY_COLOR_TEAL);

  auto &tensorStateSlot = theContext.emplaceStateSlot<TensorStateSlot>(
      static_cast<size_t>(*bBufferSlot));

  // Always borrow the buffer.
  ErrorOrSuccess errOr = tensorStateSlot.setBuffer(buffer.get().borrow());

  if (errOr.isError())
    return std::move(outChain).setToError(errOr.takeError());
  std::move(outChain).emplace();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// registerMGPPrimitives
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

void M::registerMGPPrimitives(PrimitiveRegistry &registry) {
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.runtime.create", mgp_runtime_create);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.device_context.select_stream",
                mgp_device_context_select_stream);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.buffer.cache", mgp_buffer_cache);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.context.create", mgp_context_create);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.generic.execute", mgp_generic_execute);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.device_graph.collective.execute",
                mgp_device_graph_collective_execute);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.list.append", mgp_list_append);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.guard", mgp_guard);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.list.concat", mgp_list_concat);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.list.create", mgp_list_create);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.list.get", mgp_list_get);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.list.insert", mgp_list_insert);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.list.slice", mgp_list_slice);
  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.model", mgp_model);

  ADD_PRIMITIVE(registry, "mgp.extend.lifetime", mgp_nop);

  registerMGPCPUPrimitives(registry);
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// ODS-Generated Definitions

#define GEN_PASS_DEF_EXECINVARIANTCODEMOTIONPASS
#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Transforms/MGPTransforms.h.inc"

namespace {

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Predicates
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// Returns op's buffer result if op can be lifted into 'init', else null.
static Value getLiftableBufferOp(Operation *op) {
  if (auto liftableOp = dyn_cast<MGPLiftableBufferCreateOpInterface>(op))
    return liftableOp.getOutBuffer();
  return nullptr;
}

static llvm::SmallVector<Value> getLiftableIndexOutputs(Operation *op) {
  llvm::SmallVector<Value> res;
  if (auto kernelOp = dyn_cast<MOGG::AsyncRoutineOp>(op)) {
    for (Value result : op->getResults()) {
      if (result.getType().isIntOrIndex() ||
          MOSH::ShapeAttr::isDimType(result.getType()))
        res.push_back(result);
    }
  }
  return res;
}

static std::pair<TypedValue<MEF::ChainType>, uint64_t>
cacheIntValue(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
              TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
              ContextCreateOp contextCreateOp, Value intValue) {
  intValue = dimensionToIndex(builder, loc, intValue);
  uint64_t intSlot = contextCreateOp.getNumSlots();
  contextCreateOp.setNumSlots(intSlot + 1);

  auto cacheOp = IntCacheOp::create(builder, loc, /*inChain=*/inChain,
                                    /*theContext=*/contextCreateOp,
                                    /*value=*/intValue,
                                    /*bIntSlot=*/intSlot);
  return {cacheOp.getOutChain(), intSlot};
}

static Value getCachedIntValue(OpBuilder &builder, Location loc,
                               TypedValue<ContextType> context,
                               TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> inChain,
                               uint64_t intSlot, Type resultType) {
  auto parentOp = builder.getBlock()->getParentOp();
  if (!isa<ModelOp>(parentOp))
    parentOp = parentOp->getParentOfType<MGP::ModelOp>();

  auto modelOp = cast<ModelOp>(parentOp);
  Value intSlotIndex = mlir::index::ConstantOp::create(builder, loc, intSlot);
  if (modelOp.getIsSubgraph()) {
    intSlotIndex = mlir::index::AddOp::create(builder, loc, intSlotIndex,
                                              modelOp.getSubgraphIndex());
  }

  Value intValue =
      IntGetCachedOp::create(builder, loc, builder.getIndexType(),
                             /*inChain=*/inChain, /*theContext=*/context,
                             /*bIntSlot=*/intSlotIndex);
  intValue = indexToDimension(builder, loc, intValue);
  return intValue;
}

/// Caches the integer and dimension results of a lifted op that 'execute'
/// still uses, and replaces those uses with values read back from the cache.
/// A compiled region that also returns a chain takes the chain path, so this
/// runs there too: otherwise its dims would move to 'init' with nothing in
/// 'execute' to read them back.
static void
cacheLiftedIndexResults(InitState &initState, ExecuteState &executeState,
                        Operation *liftedOp,
                        TypedValue<MEF::ChainType> cacheInputChain,
                        SmallVectorImpl<Value> &finalOutChains,
                        function_ref<bool(const OpOperand &)> isUnliftable) {
  for (Value oldIndexOut : getLiftableIndexOutputs(liftedOp)) {
    if (!llvm::any_of(oldIndexOut.getUses(), isUnliftable))
      continue;

    auto [cacheOutChain, currIndexSlot] =
        cacheIntValue(initState.builder, liftedOp->getLoc(), cacheInputChain,
                      initState.contextCreateOp, oldIndexOut);

    finalOutChains.push_back(cacheOutChain);

    auto newIndex = getCachedIntValue(
        executeState.builder, liftedOp->getLoc(), executeState.getContext(),
        executeState.getRootChain(), currIndexSlot, oldIndexOut.getType());

    oldIndexOut.replaceUsesWithIf(newIndex, isUnliftable);
    LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
               << "will lift shape function output and replace old index:\n"
               << oldIndexOut << "\nwith:\n"
               << newIndex << "\nvia cached:\n"
               << cacheOutChain << "\n");
  }
}

/// Returns true if op is liftable but trivial to compute. Such an op is not
/// worth lifting unless another 'init' op needs it: caching and retrieving
/// its result costs more than recomputing it on every 'execute'.
static bool isLiftableTrivialOp(Operation *op) {
  if (isMemoryEffectFree(op))
    return true;

  if (auto liftableOp = dyn_cast<MGPLiftableBufferCreateOpInterface>(op))
    return liftableOp.isTrivial();
  return false;
}

/// Returns op's chain result if op can be lifted into 'init', else null. The
/// chain must then flow into the 'init' output chain, which feeds the
/// 'execute' input chain.
static Value getLiftableChainOp(Operation *op) {
  if (auto createChainOp = dyn_cast<GRT::ChainCreateOp>(op))
    return createChainOp.getResult();
  if (auto regionOp = dyn_cast<MOGG::AsyncRoutineOp>(op)) {
    // TODO(GEX-4344): The 'liftable' interfaces assume an op returns at most
    // one value, which forces this special case for multi-result regions.
    // A chain plus dimension results can move to 'init': the chain is ordered
    // there, and each dimension is cached. Any other extra result has no cache
    // slot, so the region stays in 'execute'. The cache round-trip stores an
    // index and restores a dimension, so a plain integer result would change
    // type on the way back.
    if (regionOp->getNumResults() > 1) {
      if (!isa<MEF::ChainType>(regionOp->getResult(0).getType()))
        return nullptr;
      for (Value result : llvm::drop_begin(regionOp->getResults()))
        if (!MOSH::ShapeAttr::isDimType(result.getType()))
          return nullptr;
      return regionOp->getResult(0);
    }
  }
  if (auto createChainOp = dyn_cast<MGPLiftableChainCreateOpInterface>(op))
    return createChainOp.getOutChain();
  return nullptr;
}

/// Return true if the result of op can be conveyed from the 'init' block
/// to the 'execute' block via the !mgp.context cache or 'execute' block
/// arguments.
static bool canBeConveyed(Operation *op) {
  return getLiftableBufferOp(op) || getLiftableChainOp(op) ||
         !getLiftableIndexOutputs(op).empty();
}

/// Returns true if op's result cannot be cached but op may run in both 'init'
/// and 'execute', which lets downstream ops be lifted too.
static bool isRecomputableOp(Operation *op) { return isMemoryEffectFree(op); }

/// Returns true if the execution of op could be safely lifted or copied to
/// the 'init' block without causing unintended side effects.
static bool canBeLifted(Operation *op) {
  // NOTE(MAXPLAT-70): some external constants are externally mutable (e.g.
  // torch tensors might be mutated by someone outside our stack), so we cannot
  // lift them to the init phase.
  if (auto externalConstOp = dyn_cast<BufferConstantExternalOp>(op))
    if (externalConstOp.getDHasAlias())
      return false;
  return canBeConveyed(op) || isRecomputableOp(op);
}

// The analyses below reuse the 'dense' machinery (per Value/OpOperand) though
// a 'sparse' per-Operation analysis would do. Control flow ops and their
// contents are treated as unliftable, overriding some default dataflow
// results.
// TODO(#24751): Support lifting of and from within control flow.

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// DependsOnArgsAnalysis
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

using OperationSet = IndexSet<Operation *>::Set;

/// A dense, forwards dataflow analysis to find ops which cannot be lifted
/// from the 'init' to the 'execute' block because:
///  - The op is already considered unliftable by an earlier analysis (if any).
///  - The op depends on an argument to the 'execute' block (other than the
///    !mef.chain and !mgp.context arguments).
///  - The op is a terminator.
///  - The op is, or is within, a control flow op.
///  - The op has side effects which must be observed on each call to the
///    'execute' block, and cannot instead be performed just once in the 'init'
///    block.
///  - The op depends on the result of an unliftable op.
///
/// We consider ops already in the 'init' block to be liftable so that
/// the 'init' block outputs don't taint the first two 'execute' block inputs
/// as being unliftable. This allows us to use the standard dataflow machinery.
///
/// During the analysis a value will be 'true' (ie mapped to a set containing
/// the distinguished value) if it is an 'execute' block arg or produced
/// by an unliftable op.
class DependsOnArgsAnalysis {
public:
  OperationSet unliftableOps;

  DependsOnArgsAnalysis(IndexSet<Value> *index,
                        IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex,
                        OperationSet unliftableOps)
      : unliftableOps(std::move(unliftableOps)), operationIndex(operationIndex),
        analysis(index), dependsOnArgsValues(index->emptySet()) {
    setup();
  }

  void print(llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
    analysis.printPredicate(os, "dependsOnArgsValues", dependsOnArgsValues);
    llvm::dbgs() << "unliftable ops: ";
    operationIndex->printVs(llvm::dbgs(),
                            operationIndex->setToVector(unliftableOps));
    llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
  }

private:
  using Analysis = ForwardsRelationDataflowAnalysis;
  using DomainMap = Analysis::DomainMap;

  void flowGeneric(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool isAlreadyUnliftable = operationIndex->setContains(unliftableOps, op);
    Analysis::Set set = domainMap.bottom;
    for (Value operand : op->getOperands()) {
      domainMap.leastUpperBound(set,
                                analysis.getEntriesAndId(domainMap, operand));
    }
    bool hasUnliftableOperands =
        set.test(0); // distinguished always has index 0
    bool isNotLiftable = !canBeLifted(op);
    bool inControlFlow = !isExactlyOnce(op);
    bool isUnliftable = isAlreadyUnliftable || hasUnliftableOperands ||
                        isNotLiftable || inControlFlow;
    if (isUnliftable) {
      LLVM_DEBUG({
        llvm::dbgs() << "DependsOnAnalysis: considering ";
        operationIndex->printV(llvm::dbgs(), op);
        llvm::dbgs() << " to be unliftable. isAlreadyUnliftable="
                     << isAlreadyUnliftable
                     << ", hasUnliftableOperands=" << hasUnliftableOperands
                     << ", isNotLiftable=" << isNotLiftable
                     << ", inControlFlow=" << inControlFlow << "\n";
      });
      operationIndex->addToSet(unliftableOps, op);
    }
    for (Value result : op->getResults()) {
      if (isUnliftable)
        analysis.setTrue(domainMap, result);
      else
        analysis.setDefault(domainMap, result);
    }
  }

  void flow(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool inInitBlock =
        op->getParentRegion()->isAncestor(&analysis.index->model.getInit());
    if (auto cfOp = dyn_cast<GRT::GRTControlFlowInterface>(op)) {
      analysis.flowControlFlow(
          cfOp, domainMap,
          std::bind(&DependsOnArgsAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
      if (!inInitBlock) {
        // Control flow ops and their results are intrinsically unliftable.
        operationIndex->addToSet(unliftableOps, op);
        for (Value result : op->getResults())
          analysis.setTrue(domainMap, result);
      }
    } else if (isa<MEF::OutputOp>(op)) {
      if (!inInitBlock) {
        operationIndex->addToSet(unliftableOps, op);
      }
    } else if (inInitBlock) {
      // Ignore 'init' block ops.
      analysis.flowDefault(op, domainMap);
    } else {
      flowGeneric(op, domainMap);
    }
  }

  void setup() {
    Analysis::Relation dependsOnArgsRelation;
    DomainMap domainMap(dependsOnArgsRelation, Analysis::kLubIsUnion,
                        analysis.index->emptySet(),
                        analysis.index->unitSet(analysis.index->distinguished));

    // The extra 'execute' args (ie not the !mef.chain, !mgp.context, weights
    // registry, or devices) vacuously depend on 'execute' args.
    for (Value arg : analysis.index->model.getExecuteInputs())
      analysis.setTrue(domainMap, arg);

    analysis.flowModel(analysis.index->model, domainMap,
                       std::bind(&DependsOnArgsAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
    analysis.addToPredicate(dependsOnArgsValues, dependsOnArgsRelation);
  }

  IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex;
  Analysis analysis;
  // Computed only for use by print for debugging.
  Analysis::Set dependsOnArgsValues;
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// SuppressTrivialAnalysis
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// A dense, backwards dataflow analysis to find ops which cannot be lifted
/// from the 'init' to the 'execute' block because:
///  - the op is already considered unliftable by an earlier analysis.
///  - the op is trivial to compute and only used by unliftable ops, so
///    caching costs about as much as recomputing.
///  - the op's results are unused (DCE will remove it anyway).
///
/// During the analysis an operand will be 'true' (ie mapped to a set
/// containing the distinguished value) its using op is unliftable.
class SuppressTrivialAnalysis {
public:
  OperationSet unliftableOps;

  SuppressTrivialAnalysis(IndexSet<const OpOperand *> *index,
                          IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex,
                          OperationSet unliftableOps)
      : unliftableOps(std::move(unliftableOps)), operationIndex(operationIndex),
        analysis(index), suppressTrivialOperands(index->emptySet()) {
    setup();
  }

  void print(llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
    analysis.printPredicate(os, "suppressTrivialOperands",
                            suppressTrivialOperands);
    llvm::dbgs() << "unliftable ops: ";
    operationIndex->printVs(llvm::dbgs(),
                            operationIndex->setToVector(unliftableOps));
    llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
  }

private:
  using Analysis = BackwardsRelationDataflowAnalysis;
  using DomainMap = Analysis::DomainMap;

  void flowGeneric(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool isAlreadyUnliftable = operationIndex->setContains(unliftableOps, op);
    bool isTrivial = isLiftableTrivialOp(op);
    Analysis::Set set = domainMap.bottom;
    for (OpOperand &operand : op->getUses()) {
      domainMap.leastUpperBound(set,
                                analysis.getEntriesAndId(domainMap, &operand));
    }
    bool allUsesUnliftable = set.test(0); // distinguished always has index 0
    bool isUnliftable = isAlreadyUnliftable || (isTrivial && allUsesUnliftable);
    if (isUnliftable) {
      LLVM_DEBUG({
        llvm::dbgs() << "SuppressTrivialAnalysis: considering ";
        operationIndex->printV(llvm::dbgs(), op);
        llvm::dbgs() << " to be unliftable. isAlreadyUnliftable="
                     << isAlreadyUnliftable << ", isTrivial=" << isTrivial
                     << ", allUsesUnliftable=" << allUsesUnliftable << "\n";
      });
      operationIndex->addToSet(unliftableOps, op);
    }
    for (const OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands()) {
      if (isUnliftable)
        analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &opOperand);
      else
        analysis.setDefault(domainMap, &opOperand);
    }
  }

  void flow(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool inInitBlock =
        op->getParentRegion()->isAncestor(&analysis.index->model.getInit());
    if (auto cfOp = dyn_cast<GRT::GRTControlFlowInterface>(op)) {
      // Usual control flow rules.
      analysis.flowControlFlow(
          cfOp, domainMap,
          std::bind(&SuppressTrivialAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
      if (!inInitBlock) {
        // Control flow ops are unliftable, so all their operands are too.
        for (const OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands())
          analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &opOperand);
      }
    } else if (isa<MEF::OutputOp>(op)) {
      // Ignore 'plumbing'.
    } else if (inInitBlock) {
      // Ignore the 'init' block ops.
      analysis.flowDefault(op, domainMap);
    } else {
      flowGeneric(op, domainMap);
    }
  }

  void setup() {
    Analysis::Relation suppressTrivialRelation;
    DomainMap domainMap(suppressTrivialRelation, Analysis::kLubIsIntersection,
                        analysis.index->emptySet(),
                        analysis.index->unitSet(analysis.index->distinguished));

    // All 'execute' block outputs can be considered to be unliftable.
    for (OpOperand &result : analysis.index->model.getExecuteBlock()
                                 ->getTerminator()
                                 ->getOpOperands())
      analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &result);

    analysis.flowModel(analysis.index->model, domainMap,
                       std::bind(&SuppressTrivialAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
    analysis.addToPredicate(suppressTrivialOperands, suppressTrivialRelation);
  }

  IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex;
  Analysis analysis;
  // Computed only for use by print for debugging.
  Analysis::Set suppressTrivialOperands;
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// SuppressMutatedAnalysis
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// A dense, backwards dataflow analysis to find ops which cannot be lifted
/// from the 'init' to the 'execute' block because:
///  - the op is already considered unliftable by an earlier analysis.
///  - at least one of the op's results is mutated by an op which cannot
///    be lifted. Since values held by the !mgp.context cache are read-only,
///    attempting to lift the op would result in a runtime error.
///
/// During the analysis an operand will be 'true' (ie mapped to a set
/// containing the distinguished value) if it is mutated by an unliftable op.
class SuppressMutatedAnalysis {
public:
  OperationSet unliftableOps;

  SuppressMutatedAnalysis(IndexSet<const OpOperand *> *index,
                          IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex,
                          OperationSet unliftableOps)
      : unliftableOps(std::move(unliftableOps)), operationIndex(operationIndex),
        analysis(index), suppressMutatedOperands(index->emptySet()) {
    setup();
  }

  void print(llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
    analysis.printPredicate(os, "suppressMutatedOperands",
                            suppressMutatedOperands);
    llvm::dbgs() << "unliftable ops: ";
    operationIndex->printVs(llvm::dbgs(),
                            operationIndex->setToVector(unliftableOps));
    llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
  }

private:
  using Analysis = BackwardsRelationDataflowAnalysis;
  using DomainMap = Analysis::DomainMap;

  void flowGeneric(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool isAlreadyUnliftable = operationIndex->setContains(unliftableOps, op);
    Analysis::Set set = domainMap.bottom;
    for (OpOperand &operand : op->getUses()) {
      domainMap.leastUpperBound(set,
                                analysis.getEntriesAndId(domainMap, &operand));
    }
    bool anyUsesMutatedByUnliftable =
        set.test(0); // distinguished olways has index 0
    bool isUnliftable = isAlreadyUnliftable || anyUsesMutatedByUnliftable;
    if (isUnliftable) {
      LLVM_DEBUG({
        llvm::dbgs() << "SuppressMutatedAnalysis: considering ";
        operationIndex->printV(llvm::dbgs(), op);
        llvm::dbgs() << " to be unliftable. isAlreadyUnliftable="
                     << isAlreadyUnliftable << ", anyUsesMutatedByUnliftable="
                     << anyUsesMutatedByUnliftable << "\n";
      });
      operationIndex->addToSet(unliftableOps, op);
    }
    // Only suppress upstream ops whose results this unliftable op *mutates*.
    for (OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands()) {
      if (isUnliftable && isMutated(opOperand))
        analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &opOperand);
      else
        analysis.setDefault(domainMap, &opOperand);
    }
  }

  void flow(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool inInitBlock =
        op->getParentRegion()->isAncestor(&analysis.index->model.getInit());
    if (auto cfOp = dyn_cast<GRT::GRTControlFlowInterface>(op)) {
      // Usual control flow rules.
      analysis.flowControlFlow(
          cfOp, domainMap,
          std::bind(&SuppressMutatedAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
    } else if (isa<MEF::OutputOp>(op)) {
      // Ignore 'plumbing'.
    } else if (inInitBlock) {
      // Ignore the 'init' block ops.
      analysis.flowDefault(op, domainMap);
    } else {
      flowGeneric(op, domainMap);
    }
  }

  void setup() {
    Analysis::Relation suppressMutatedRelation;
    DomainMap domainMap(suppressMutatedRelation, Analysis::kLubIsUnion,
                        analysis.index->emptySet(),
                        analysis.index->unitSet(analysis.index->distinguished));

    // 'execute' block outputs are not mutated by the output, so stay 'false'.
    analysis.flowModel(analysis.index->model, domainMap,
                       std::bind(&SuppressMutatedAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
    analysis.addToPredicate(suppressMutatedOperands, suppressMutatedRelation);
  }

  IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex;
  Analysis analysis;
  // Computed only for use by print for debugging.
  Analysis::Set suppressMutatedOperands;
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// NeedToCloneAnalysis
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

/// A dense, backwards dataflow analysis to find ops which, though liftable,
/// must also be 'left behind' in the 'execute' block by cloning. The op must
/// be cloned if it is i) liftable, and ii) its results cannot be conveyed via
/// the !mgp.context or 'execute' block args, and iii) any:
///  - it provides operands to an unliftable op
///  - it provides operands to an op already considered needing to be cloned
///    by this analysis.
///
/// During the analysis an operand will be 'true' (ie mapped to a set
/// containing the distinguished value) if it is an operand to an unliftable
/// op or an op already recognized as needing to be cloned.
class NeedToCloneAnalysis {
public:
  OperationSet clonedOps;

  NeedToCloneAnalysis(IndexSet<const OpOperand *> *index,
                      IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex,
                      const OperationSet &unliftableOps)
      : clonedOps(operationIndex->emptySet()), operationIndex(operationIndex),
        unliftableOps(unliftableOps), analysis(index),
        needToCloneOperands(index->emptySet()) {
    setup();
  }

  void print(llvm::raw_ostream &os) {
    analysis.printPredicate(os, "needToCloneOperands", needToCloneOperands);
    llvm::dbgs() << "cloned ops: ";
    operationIndex->printVs(llvm::dbgs(),
                            operationIndex->setToVector(clonedOps));
    llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
  }

private:
  using Analysis = BackwardsRelationDataflowAnalysis;
  using DomainMap = Analysis::DomainMap;

  void flowGeneric(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    if (operationIndex->setContains(unliftableOps, op)) {
      // Ops which produce these operands may need to be cloned.
      for (OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands())
        analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &opOperand);
    } else if (canBeConveyed(op)) {
      // Results are recovered in 'execute', so operands constrain nothing
      // upstream.
      analysis.flowDefault(op, domainMap);
    } else {
      Analysis::Set set = domainMap.bottom;
      for (OpOperand &operand : op->getUses()) {
        domainMap.leastUpperBound(
            set, analysis.getEntriesAndId(domainMap, &operand));
      }
      bool neededByClonedOrUnliftable =
          set.test(0); // distinguished olways has index 0
      if (neededByClonedOrUnliftable) {
        LLVM_DEBUG({
          llvm::dbgs() << "NeedToCloneAnalysis: considering ";
          operationIndex->printV(llvm::dbgs(), op);
          llvm::dbgs() << " to require cloning. neededByClonedOrUnliftable="
                       << neededByClonedOrUnliftable << "\n";
        });
        operationIndex->addToSet(clonedOps, op);
      }
      for (OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands()) {
        if (neededByClonedOrUnliftable)
          analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &opOperand);
        else
          analysis.setDefault(domainMap, &opOperand);
      }
    }
  }

  void flow(Operation *op, DomainMap &domainMap) {
    bool inInitBlock =
        op->getParentRegion()->isAncestor(&analysis.index->model.getInit());
    if (auto cfOp = dyn_cast<GRT::GRTControlFlowInterface>(op)) {
      // Usual control flow rules.
      analysis.flowControlFlow(
          cfOp, domainMap, std::bind(&NeedToCloneAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
      if (!inInitBlock) {
        // Control flow ops are unliftable, so all their operands are too.
        for (OpOperand &opOperand : op->getOpOperands())
          analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &opOperand);
      }
    } else if (isa<MEF::OutputOp>(op)) {
      // Ignore 'plumbing'.
    } else if (inInitBlock) {
      // Ignore 'init' block ops.
      analysis.flowDefault(op, domainMap);
    } else {
      flowGeneric(op, domainMap);
    }
  }

  void setup() {
    Analysis::Relation neededByExecuteRelation;
    DomainMap domainMap(neededByExecuteRelation, Analysis::kLubIsUnion,
                        analysis.index->emptySet(),
                        analysis.index->unitSet(analysis.index->distinguished));

    // All 'execute' block outputs are vacuously needed an unliftable op.
    for (OpOperand &result : analysis.index->model.getExecuteBlock()
                                 ->getTerminator()
                                 ->getOpOperands())
      analysis.setTrue(domainMap, &result);

    analysis.flowModel(analysis.index->model, domainMap,
                       std::bind(&NeedToCloneAnalysis::flow, this, _1, _2));
    analysis.addToPredicate(needToCloneOperands, neededByExecuteRelation);
  }

  IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex;
  const OperationSet &unliftableOps;
  Analysis analysis;
  // Computed only for use by print for debugging.
  Analysis::Set needToCloneOperands;
};

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// ExecInvariantCodeMotionPass
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

class ExecInvariantCodeMotionPass
    : public impl::ExecInvariantCodeMotionPassBase<
          ExecInvariantCodeMotionPass> {
  using ExecInvariantCodeMotionPassBase::ExecInvariantCodeMotionPassBase;

  // Returns the unliftable 'execute' ops and the liftable ones that must be
  // cloned before lifting.
  std::pair<OperationSet, OperationSet> analyze(ModelOp modelOp) {
    OperationSet unliftableOps = operationIndex->emptySet();
    size_t origNumUnliftableOps;

    do {
      origNumUnliftableOps = unliftableOps.count();
      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "-------- analysis iteration --------\n");

      // Don't lift if depends on 'execute' block args.
      DependsOnArgsAnalysis dependsOnArgsAnalysis(valueIndex, operationIndex,
                                                  std::move(unliftableOps));
      LLVM_DEBUG(dependsOnArgsAnalysis.print(llvm::dbgs()));

      // Don't lift if trivial to recompute and only used by unliftable.
      SuppressTrivialAnalysis suppressTrivialAnalysis(
          operandIndex, operationIndex,
          std::move(dependsOnArgsAnalysis.unliftableOps));
      LLVM_DEBUG(suppressTrivialAnalysis.print(llvm::dbgs()));

      // Don't lift if mutated by an unliftable op.
      SuppressMutatedAnalysis suppressMutatedAnalysis(
          operandIndex, operationIndex,
          std::move(suppressTrivialAnalysis.unliftableOps));
      LLVM_DEBUG(suppressMutatedAnalysis.print(llvm::dbgs()));

      unliftableOps = std::move(suppressMutatedAnalysis.unliftableOps);
    } while (origNumUnliftableOps < unliftableOps.count());

    NeedToCloneAnalysis needToCloneAnalysis(operandIndex, operationIndex,
                                            unliftableOps);

    LLVM_DEBUG({
      llvm::dbgs() << "-------- analysis fixed point --------------\n";
      needToCloneAnalysis.print(llvm::dbgs());
      llvm::dbgs() << "--------------------------------------------\n";
    });

    return {std::move(unliftableOps), std::move(needToCloneAnalysis.clonedOps)};
  }

  void rewrite(const std::pair<OperationSet, OperationSet> &sets) {
    DenseSet<Operation *> unliftableOps;
    for (Operation *op : operationIndex->values(sets.first))
      unliftableOps.insert(op);
    DenseSet<Operation *> cloneOps;
    for (Operation *op : operationIndex->values(sets.second))
      cloneOps.insert(op);

    auto isOpOperandUnliftable = [&unliftableOps](const OpOperand &operand) {
      return unliftableOps.contains(operand.getOwner());
    };

    auto initOutputOp = cast<MEF::OutputOp>(*initState->init->rbegin());
    Value initOriginalChain = initState->getFinalChain();
    Location outputLoc = initOutputOp.getLoc();
    initState->builder.setInsertionPoint(initOutputOp);

    // A host-chain placeholder gating the caching of lifted buffers until all
    // side effects on them complete; replaced once lifting is done.
    auto placeholderBufferCacheInputChain =
        GRT::ChainCreateOp::create(initState->builder, outputLoc);

    // TODO(#24751): The following chain dependencies may be too aggressive,
    // relax via some analysis

    // Chains of side effects on lifted buffers; caching waits for ALL of them.
    SmallVector<Value> potentialBufferActionChains;

    // Cache-insertion chains, joined into the final 'init' output chain.
    SmallVector<Value> finalOutChains{initOriginalChain};

    // TODO(#24751): We only consider ops in the top-level 'execute' block.
    SmallVector<Operation *> allOps = getDataflowOrder(executeState->execute);

    LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "first pass...\n");

    // Clone in a separate first pass so lifted results are renamed in the
    // right places.
    IRMapping cloneIRMapping;
    for (Operation *op : allOps) {
      if (!cloneOps.contains(op))
        continue;
      LLVM_DEBUG({
        llvm::dbgs() << "cloning ";
        operationIndex->printV(llvm::dbgs(), op);
        llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
      });
      ASSERT_STREAM(!unliftableOps.contains(op),
                    << "attempting to clone an op (" << *op
                    << ") which is unliftable");
      ASSERT_STREAM(isRecomputableOp(op), << "attempting to clone an op ("
                                          << *op
                                          << ") which is not recomputable");

      // For easier debugging only.
      executeState->builder.setInsertionPoint(op);

      Operation *clonedOp = executeState->builder.clone(*op, cloneIRMapping);
      // Clones stay in 'execute'.
      unliftableOps.insert(clonedOp);
      op->replaceUsesWithIf(clonedOp, isOpOperandUnliftable);
    }

    LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "second pass...\n");

    for (Operation *op : allOps) {
      if (unliftableOps.contains(op))
        continue;
      LLVM_DEBUG({
        llvm::dbgs() << "moving ";
        operationIndex->printV(llvm::dbgs(), op);
        llvm::dbgs() << "\n";
      });

      // For easier debugging only.
      executeState->builder.setInsertionPoint(op);

      if (Value oldChain = getLiftableChainOp(op)) {
        // Uses staying in 'execute' switch to its root chain (CSE dedups);
        // other uses are lifted along with op.
        Value newChain = executeState->getRootChain();
        oldChain.replaceUsesWithIf(newChain, isOpOperandUnliftable);
        LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "will lift chain op and replace old chain:\n"
                                << oldChain << "\nwith:\n"
                                << newChain << "\n");
        cacheLiftedIndexResults(*initState, *executeState, op,
                                placeholderBufferCacheInputChain,
                                finalOutChains, isOpOperandUnliftable);

      } else if (Value oldBuffer = getLiftableBufferOp(op)) {
        // Uses staying in 'execute' read the buffer back from the cache.
        if (llvm::any_of(op->getUses(), isOpOperandUnliftable)) {
          // Caching must wait for every writer. Rather than track writers per
          // buffer, *all* buffers wait for *all* writers.
          for (OpOperand &use : op->getUses()) {
            if (isMutated(use)) {
              // Fires when the parent is liftable but a "trivial" child is
              // not. Cloning the parent or moving the child would fix it, but
              // very few ops are trivial.
              ASSERT_STREAM(!isOpOperandUnliftable(use),
                            << "attempting to lift buffer (" << *op
                            << ") which will be further mutated "
                               "in the 'execute' block");
              for (Value res : use.getOwner()->getResults()) {
                if (isa<MEF::MEFChainTypeInterface>(res.getType()))
                  potentialBufferActionChains.push_back(res);
              }
            }
          }

          MGPBufferBuilder *bufferBuilder =
              TensorBufferDialectInterface::getBuilderForTypeStorage(
                  *builderContext, oldBuffer.getType());
          auto [bufferCacheOutChain, currBufferSlot] = bufferBuilder->cache(
              initState->builder, op->getLoc(), initState->getContext(),
              placeholderBufferCacheInputChain, initState->contextCreateOp,
              oldBuffer);

          finalOutChains.push_back(bufferCacheOutChain);

          auto newBuffer = bufferBuilder->getCached(
              executeState->builder, op->getLoc(), executeState->getContext(),
              executeState->getRootChain(), currBufferSlot,
              oldBuffer.getType());

          oldBuffer.replaceUsesWithIf(newBuffer, isOpOperandUnliftable);
          LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
                     << "will lift buffer op and replace old buffer:\n"
                     << oldBuffer << "\nwith:\n"
                     << newBuffer << "\nvia cached:\n"
                     << bufferCacheOutChain << "\n");
        } else {
          LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "will lift buffer op without caching\n");
        }

      } else if (!getLiftableIndexOutputs(op).empty()) {
        cacheLiftedIndexResults(*initState, *executeState, op,
                                placeholderBufferCacheInputChain,
                                finalOutChains, isOpOperandUnliftable);

      } else {
        ASSERT_STREAM(isRecomputableOp(op),
                      << "attempting to lift an op (" << *op
                      << ") which is neither a liftable chain or "
                         "buffer op, nor a recomputable op");

        // Note that the op may have been cloned by the first pass.
      }

      LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs() << "considering op to be recomputable:\n"
                              << *op << "\n");
      op->moveBefore(initOutputOp);
    }

    auto isInInitBlock = [this](OpOperand &operand) -> bool {
      return operand.getOwner()->getBlock() == initState->init;
    };

    // Lifted ops now use the 'init' equivalents of the 'execute' block args;
    // the chain is the 'init' output chain from before the updates above.
    executeState->getRootChain().replaceUsesWithIf(initOriginalChain,
                                                   isInInitBlock);

    executeState->getContext().replaceUsesWithIf(initState->contextCreateOp,
                                                 isInInitBlock);

    for (auto [execDeviceContext, initDeviceContext] :
         llvm::zip(executeState->getDevices(), initState->getDevices()))
      execDeviceContext.replaceUsesWithIf(initDeviceContext, isInInitBlock);

    executeState->getWeightsRegistry().replaceUsesWithIf(
        initState->getWeightsRegistry(), isInInitBlock);

    placeholderBufferCacheInputChain.replaceAllUsesWith(
        GRT::ChainCreateOp::create(initState->builder, outputLoc,
                                   potentialBufferActionChains)
            .getResult());
    placeholderBufferCacheInputChain.erase();

    auto mergedFinalOutChain = GRT::ChainCreateOp::create(
        initState->builder, outputLoc, finalOutChains);
    initState->updateFinalChain(mergedFinalOutChain);
  }

  void runOnOperation() override {
    assert(!initState && !executeState && !valueIndex && !operandIndex &&
           !operationIndex && !builderContext);
    ModelOp modelOp = getOperation();
    InitState theInitState(modelOp);
    initState = &theInitState;
    ExecuteState theExecuteState(modelOp.getContext(), modelOp);
    executeState = &theExecuteState;
    IndexSet<Value> theValueIndex = createValueIndexSet(modelOp);
    valueIndex = &theValueIndex;
    IndexSet<const OpOperand *> theOperandIndex =
        createOperandIndexSet(modelOp);
    operandIndex = &theOperandIndex;
    IndexSet<Operation *> theOperationIndex = createOperationIndexSet(modelOp);
    operationIndex = &theOperationIndex;

    BufferBuilderContext theBuilderContext =
        TensorBufferDialectInterface::getAllBufferBuilders(modelOp);
    builderContext = &theBuilderContext;

    LLVM_DEBUG({
      llvm::dbgs() << "-------- before ExecInvariantCodeMotionPass --------\n";
      valueIndex->printModel(llvm::dbgs());
      llvm::dbgs() << "----------------------------------------------------\n";
    });

    rewrite(analyze(modelOp));

    // Clear state because the instance might be reused
    builderContext = nullptr;
    operationIndex = nullptr;
    operandIndex = nullptr;
    valueIndex = nullptr;
    executeState = nullptr;
    initState = nullptr;
  }

  /// Rewrite helpers.
  InitState *initState = nullptr;
  ExecuteState *executeState = nullptr;
  IndexSet<Value> *valueIndex = nullptr;
  IndexSet<const OpOperand *> *operandIndex = nullptr;
  IndexSet<Operation *> *operationIndex = nullptr;

  /// All the type and buffer builders we'll need while working on the model.
  BufferBuilderContext *builderContext = nullptr;
};

#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Dialect/MGPBufferLifetimeAnalysis.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Dialect/MGPOps.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Transforms/MGPTransforms.h"
#include "GraphCompiler/MOGGDialect/MOGGOps.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/DenseMapInfo.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/Hashing.h"
#include "llvm/ADT/STLExtras.h"

#define DEBUG_TYPE "mgp-simple-buffer-reuse"

using namespace mlir;

namespace M {
namespace MGP {

struct ReuseKey {
  mlir::TypedValue<mlir::IndexType> size;
  Attribute device;
  uint64_t alignment;

  bool operator==(const ReuseKey &other) const {
    return size == other.size && device == other.device &&
           alignment == other.alignment;
  }
};

} // namespace MGP
} // namespace M

namespace llvm {
template <>
struct DenseMapInfo<M::MGP::ReuseKey> {
  using KeyTy = M::MGP::ReuseKey;

  static unsigned getHashValue(const KeyTy &k) {
    return hash_combine(DenseMapInfo<mlir::Value>::getHashValue(k.size),
                        DenseMapInfo<Attribute>::getHashValue(k.device),
                        DenseMapInfo<uint64_t>::getHashValue(k.alignment));
  }

  static bool isEqual(const KeyTy &a, const KeyTy &b) { return a == b; }
};
} // namespace llvm

namespace M {
namespace MGP {

// Generate support code for SimpleBufferReusePass
#define GEN_PASS_DEF_SIMPLEBUFFERREUSEPASS
#include "GraphCompiler/MGPDialect/Transforms/MGPTransforms.h.inc"

class SimpleBufferReusePass
    : public impl::SimpleBufferReusePassBase<SimpleBufferReusePass> {
  using SimpleBufferReusePassBase::SimpleBufferReusePassBase;
  using LifetimeRange = std::pair<int, int>;

  struct AllocInfo {
    MGP::BufferAllocOp alloc;
    int firstUseIndex;
    int lastUseIndex;
    SmallVector<Operation *> uses;
  };

  // Reuse is safe when every current use runs after every candidate use.
  bool canSafelyReuseBuffer(ArrayRef<Operation *> currentUses,
                            ArrayRef<Operation *> candidateUses,
                            const DependencyTree &depTree) {
    if (currentUses.empty() || candidateUses.empty())
      return true;

    for (Operation *currentUse : currentUses) {
      for (Operation *candidateUse : candidateUses) {
        if (!depTree.executesAfter(currentUse, candidateUse)) {
          return false;
        }
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

public:
  void runOnOperation() override {
    ModelOp modelOp = getOperation();

    auto &analysis = getAnalysis<BufferLifetimeAnalysisPass>();
    int reuseCount = 0;

    // Erasing allocs invalidates the analysis, but the next pass only queries
    // alloc uses, which stay valid.
    markAnalysesPreserved<BufferLifetimeAnalysisPass>();

    modelOp->walk<mlir::WalkOrder::PreOrder>([&](Block *block) {
      if (isa_and_present<MOGG::AsyncRoutineOp>(block->getParentOp()))
        return WalkResult::skip();

      DenseMap<ReuseKey, SmallVector<MGP::BufferAllocOp>> allocGroups;

      for (auto allocOp : block->getOps<MGP::BufferAllocOp>()) {
        ReuseKey key = {allocOp.getRuntimeSize(), allocOp.getDevice(),
                        allocOp.getRawAlign()};
        allocGroups[key].push_back(allocOp);
      }

      if (allocGroups.empty())
        return WalkResult::advance();

      auto &depTree = analysis.getDepTree(block);

      for (auto &[key, allocs] : allocGroups) {
        if (allocs.size() < 2)
          continue;

        SmallVector<std::pair<MGP::BufferAllocOp, SmallVector<Operation *>>>
            validAllocs;
        validAllocs.reserve(allocs.size());

        for (auto alloc : allocs) {
          ErrorOr<SmallVector<Operation *>> uses = getAllocUses(alloc);
          if (!uses.isError())
            validAllocs.emplace_back(alloc, std::move(*uses));
        }

        // Allocs with more uses go first.
        llvm::stable_sort(validAllocs, [](const auto &a, const auto &b) {
          return a.second.size() > b.second.size();
        });

        for (unsigned i = 0; i < validAllocs.size(); ++i) {
          auto &pair = validAllocs[i];
          MGP::BufferAllocOp currentAlloc = pair.first;
          auto &currentUses = pair.second;
          if (!currentAlloc)
            continue; // Already erased.

          for (unsigned j = 0; j < validAllocs.size(); ++j) {
            if (i == j)
              continue;
            auto &candidatePair = validAllocs[j];
            MGP::BufferAllocOp candidateAlloc = candidatePair.first;
            auto &candidateUses = candidatePair.second;
            if (!candidateAlloc)
              continue;

            // Buffers used by the same op cannot alias without a read/write
            // conflict.
            bool sharesOperation = false;
            for (Operation *op : currentUses) {
              if (llvm::is_contained(candidateUses, op)) {
                sharesOperation = true;
                break;
              }
            }
            if (sharesOperation)
              continue;

            if (canSafelyReuseBuffer(currentUses, candidateUses, depTree)) {
              currentAlloc->replaceAllUsesWith(candidateAlloc);
              currentAlloc->erase();
              validAllocs[i].first = nullptr;

              SmallVector<Operation *> newUses;
              newUses.reserve(candidateUses.size() + currentUses.size());
              newUses.append(candidateUses.begin(), candidateUses.end());
              newUses.append(currentUses.begin(), currentUses.end());
              validAllocs[j].second = std::move(newUses);

              ++reuseCount;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }

      return WalkResult::advance();
    });

    LLVM_DEBUG(llvm::dbgs()
               << "Reused " << reuseCount << " buffer allocations\n");
  }
};

StringAttr M::MOGG::getFuncName(FusionInfoAttr fusionInfo) {
  ASSERT_STREAM(fusionInfo, << "cannot name a kernel stub without fusion info");
  // The hash keeps names that share a truncated prefix distinct in Mojo.
  return StringAttr::get(
      fusionInfo.getContext(),
      "__" + joinNameParts(fusionInfo.getLeafNames(), TruncationMarker::Hash));
}

template <typename T>
static auto stringifyMLIRObject(T entity) {
  std::string str;
  llvm::raw_string_ostream stream(str);
  entity.print(stream);

  return str;
}

static ParseResult parseDim(OpAsmParser &p, StringAttr &name) {
  return failure(p.parseLess() || KGEN::parseParamName(p, name) ||
                 p.parseGreater());
}

/// Build a Mojo expression that loads from decomposed tensor components on the
/// fusion struct, using the struct's StaticTensorSpec parameter.
static std::string buildStructLoadExpr(StringRef captureIdx,
                                       StringRef indicesExpr) {
  return llvm::formatv("{2}[static_spec = Self.spec_{0}, "
                       "simd_width = simd_width, "
                       "element_alignment = element_alignment]"
                       "(self.ptr_{0}, self.shape_{0}, self.strides_{0}, {1})",
                       captureIdx, indicesExpr, kFnMsSimdLoadFromTensorPointer)
      .str();
}

namespace {
/// The two pieces that differ between the fusion-struct and register_passable
/// paths: how a tensor capture is loaded, and the SIMD-width parameter name.
/// `emitElementwiseLambdaBodyOps` and its shells provide the shared dispatch.
struct ElementwiseBodyRenderer {
  virtual ~ElementwiseBodyRenderer() = default;
  /// Load expression for the capture at `captureIdx`, indexed by `indicesExpr`
  /// (already wrapped in an IndexList rebind).
  virtual std::string buildLoadExpr(unsigned captureIdx,
                                    StringRef indicesExpr) const = 0;
  /// SIMD-width parameter name for this body, spliced into
  /// `rebind[SIMD[<dtype>, <name>]](…)` wrappers.
  virtual StringRef simdWidthParamName() const = 0;
};

/// Fusion-struct body: loads through `self.{ptr,shape,strides}_<i>` on
/// the struct's `simd_width` method parameter.
struct FusionStructRenderer final : ElementwiseBodyRenderer {
  std::string buildLoadExpr(unsigned captureIdx,
                            StringRef indicesExpr) const override {
    return buildStructLoadExpr(std::to_string(captureIdx), indicesExpr);
  }
  StringRef simdWidthParamName() const override { return "simd_width"; }
};

/// Trait-lane fusion-functor body: loads through a dense `TileTensor` built
/// from capture <i>'s `(ptr, layout)` via `tile.load(idx)`. The functor
/// `__call__`'s width param is `width` and `idx` is a `Coord`; loads are at the
/// iteration index (`indicesExpr` is ignored, the only form simple elementwise
/// prologue fusion produces).
struct DenseFusionRenderer final : ElementwiseBodyRenderer {
  std::string buildLoadExpr(unsigned captureIdx,
                            StringRef /*indicesExpr*/) const override {
    // Captures are a bare pointer + layout, not a `TileTensor`: the encoder
    // bit-copies fields, so only a `Pointer` translates to a device address
    // (via `_to_device_type`). Rebuilding the tile here lets one body serve CPU
    // and GPU.
    auto ci = std::to_string(captureIdx);
    return llvm::formatv(
               "TileTensor[dtype=Self.dtype_{0}, LayoutType=Self.LayoutType_{0}"
               ", origin=UntrackedOrigin[mut=Self.mut_{0}]](ptr=self.ptr_{0}, "
               "layout=self.layout_{0}).load[width=width, "
               "alignment=element_alignment]({1})",
               ci, kParameterIdx)
        .str();
  }
  StringRef simdWidthParamName() const override { return "width"; }
};
} // namespace

// `except(%err) {...}`: the error is the except region's only argument, and
// its type is always `!mogg.error`.
static ParseResult parseExceptRegion(OpAsmParser &parser, Region &region) {
  SmallVector<OpAsmParser::Argument> args;
  if (parser.parseKeyword("except") ||
      parser.parseArgumentList(args, OpAsmParser::Delimiter::OptionalParen))
    return failure();
  for (OpAsmParser::Argument &arg : args)
    arg.type = ErrorType::get(parser.getContext());
  return parser.parseRegion(region, args);
}

static void printExceptRegion(OpAsmPrinter &p, Operation *, Region &region) {
  p << "except";
  if (!region.empty() && region.getNumArguments() != 0) {
    p << "(";
    llvm::interleaveComma(region.getArguments(), p);
    p << ")";
  }
  p << " ";
  p.printRegion(region, /*printEntryBlockArgs=*/false);
}

void TryOp::getAsmBlockArgumentNames(Region &region,
                                     OpAsmSetValueNameFn setNameFn) {
  if (&region == &getExceptRegion() && !region.empty())
    for (BlockArgument arg : region.getArguments())
      setNameFn(arg, "err");
}

static void printDim(OpAsmPrinter &p, Operation *op, StringAttr dim) {
  p << '<';
  KGEN::printParamName(p, dim);
  p << '>';
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MOGG ConcatOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

LogicalResult ConcatOp::lower(MGP::MOGraphLoweringState &loweringState) {
  MGP::MOOpLoweringState opLoweringState(loweringState, *this);

  SmallVector<Value> loweredOperands = opLoweringState.getLoweredOperands();

  FailureOr<SmallVector<MGP::MOOutputStorage>> loweredOutputsStorageOr =
      opLoweringState.createOutputStorage(loweringState.getExecuteChain());
  if (failed(loweredOutputsStorageOr))
    return failure();
  auto &loweredOutputsStorage = *loweredOutputsStorageOr;
  assert(loweredOutputsStorageOr->size() == 1);

  Value executeChain =
      opLoweringState.getGuardChain(loweringState.getCurrentExecuteChain());

  Value outChain = opLoweringState.bufferConcat(
      executeChain, loweredOutputsStorage[0].buffer, loweredOperands,
      getResult().getType());

  // Create the output tensors, but only once the op has completed.
  opLoweringState.createOutputs(outChain, loweredOutputsStorage);
  return success();
}

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// MOGG SplitOp
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

LogicalResult SplitOp::lower(MGP::MOGraphLoweringState &loweringState) {
  MGP::MOOpLoweringState opLoweringState(loweringState, *this);

  Value inputBuffer = opLoweringState.getBufferizedInput(getInput()).buffer;

  // TODO Enable this.
  if (inputBuffer.getDefiningOp<MGP::BufferConstantOp>())
    return emitOpError("constant input buffer is unsupported");

  // A split needs output specs only, no buffers.
  FailureOr<SmallVector<TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType>>> outputSpecsOr =
      opLoweringState.createOutputTensorSpecs();
  if (failed(outputSpecsOr))
    return failure();
  auto &outputSpecs = *outputSpecsOr;

  SmallVector<Value> outputBuffers;

  // The slices stay on the input buffer's device.
  auto sliceDeviceRef =
      cast<MGP::DeviceBufferType>(inputBuffer.getType()).getDevice();
  TypedValue<MGP::DeviceContextType> sliceDeviceContext =
      loweringState.getExecuteDevice(sliceDeviceRef);

  Value offset = opLoweringState.create<mlir::index::ConstantOp>(0).getResult();
  Value sliceSize;
  for (TypedValue<MGP::TensorSpecType> outSpec : outputSpecs) {
    if (sliceSize)
      offset = opLoweringState.create<mlir::index::AddOp>(offset, sliceSize);

    MGP::TensorSpecType outSpecTy = outSpec.getType();
    std::optional<uint64_t> bufferSize = outSpecTy.getSizeInBytes();

    if (!bufferSize.has_value()) {
      ASSERT_STREAM(outSpecTy.getOptDType().has_value(),
                    << "SplitOp output spec cannot have unknown dtype.");
      sliceSize =
          opLoweringState.bufferSizeBytes(outSpec, getInput().getType());

    } else {
      sliceSize = opLoweringState.create<mlir::index::ConstantOp>(*bufferSize)
                      .getResult();
    }

    Value outSlice = opLoweringState
                         .create<MGP::BufferSliceOp>(
                             inputBuffer, offset, sliceSize, sliceDeviceContext)
                         .getResult();
    outputBuffers.push_back(outSlice);
  }

  // The slices are only accessible once the inputs are.
  Value guardChain =
      opLoweringState.getGuardChain(loweringState.getCurrentExecuteChain());

  // Create the output tensors. Note there's no new chain to wait on.
